plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Bilingual DeepSeek Harness changelog, security-advisory and storage panel — version timeline, CVE/GHSA records and disk usage in one sidebar panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-changelog-panel

[简体中文](README_zh.md)

> Primary repo: <https://github.com/HLhhh/dsh-changelog-panel> ·
> Gitee mirror: <https://gitee.com/huang-lin-java/dsh-changelog-panel>

**A bilingual changelog, security-advisory, and storage panel for DeepSeek Harness.** Install it and the
sidebar gains one entry: what changed in every release, which CVE/GHSA records affect your install, and how
much disk space DSH itself is holding.

- Version timeline with category-grouped feature cards and keyword search
- A **Security** tab: 13 advisories with severity, affected range, fixed version, and source links
- An installed-version badge that tells you how it compares to the official latest
- Per-panel language switch (zh / en) that neither follows nor changes the rest of the shell
- A companion storage dashboard: what DSH leaves on disk, what each item costs, which conversation owns it,
  and which parts are reclaimable

## What it looks like

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Changelog & Security   7 versions · 50 records  [Changelog][Security]│
├──────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Versions     │ 0.2.0-rc.2   latest   2026-09-29                      │
│ ┌──────────┐ │ One-line summary…                                     │
│ │0.2.0-rc.2│ │ ● Agent · 6                                           │
│ │latest·33 │ │   ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│ └──────────┘ │   │ ● Title / summary / related packages          │   │
│ 0.2.0-rc.1   │   └───────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│ 0.1.7-rc.2   │ ● Tools · 8   ● Sessions · 5   ● UI · 7 …             │
└──────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Install / Update

> Not published to npm yet — install straight from GitHub.

### With the `dsh` CLI

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HLhhh/dsh-changelog-panel
```

Replace `web` with your profile name (`desktop` for the desktop app).

### With the `plugin_manager` tool (inside an agent)

Call `install_bundle` with `target` set to:

```
github:HLhhh/dsh-changelog-panel
```

### From a local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/HLhhh/dsh-changelog-panel.git
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-changelog-panel
```

The prebuilt `lib/client.js` is committed, so **no build step is required to install**.
Restart DSH (or let HMR pick it up) and refresh the page.

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-changelog-panel
```

## Features

### Changelog

- Version timeline on the left, opening on the version **you actually have installed**
- Entries grouped by category: agent, UI, tools, sessions, security, platform, plugins
- Search across titles, summaries, and related package names
- At most 12 release entries rendered per version; older ones are reachable from the timeline

### Security

- 13 advisories and CVE/GHSA records with severity, status, affected range, fixed version, and links
- A "search scope" note stating what was searched and what was not found — no unsupported claims

### Live data

The panel talks to two public endpoints **directly from your browser**; no third-party server is involved:

| Source | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` | Version list and publish times |
| `api.github.com/repos/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases` | Official release notes |

- Refreshes once on the first open of each day, plus a manual refresh button with the last refresh time
- New versions are merged into the timeline but never overwrite the verified built-in dataset
- Rate limiting is reported explicitly instead of failing silently

### Storage dashboard

The same plugin also ships a storage view: what DSH has written to your disk (session logs, attachments,
caches, runtime binaries), how much each item costs, which conversation owns it, and what can be moved to
the OS trash. It **only reports** — it never deletes on your behalf — and categories that must not be
reclaimed say why.

## Configuration

None. Language is the panel's own state (the 中文 / EN toggle in its header); it follows the shell locale by
default and only affects this panel.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.x` (developed and tested on `0.2.1-rc.2`) |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | Web (browser and desktop) |
| Dependencies | Only the peer dependency `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4`; no host package is bundled |

## Known limitations

- **No npm release yet** — GitHub or a local path only
- The built-in dataset is a point-in-time snapshot; use the manual refresh for current data
- Live refresh needs `api.github.com` and `registry.npmjs.org` to be reachable; otherwise only the built-in
  dataset is shown
- Storage figures come verbatim from the scan report; nothing is extrapolated
- Chinese entries are paraphrases, not quotations of the original advisories — consult the linked sources
  for compliance decisions

## Development

```bash
npm run build        # regenerate lib/client.js from src/
npm run data:verify  # validate the dataset
```

`lib/client.js` is generated — edit `src/` and rebuild; do not hand-edit the bundle.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件与设置备份 / 跨机同步工具：一键把全部插件、配置和插件数据打包成可移植 .zip，在新电脑上先预览再批量还原。5 个 agent 工具 + 零依赖独立 CLI；凭据默认排除、可选 AES-256-GCM 加密导出；还原默认只预览，应用前自动生成还原点。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-config-sync

把本机 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的**全部插件与设置**备份成一个可移植的 `.zip`，再批量同步到下一台电脑。

> 📖 **日常操作请看 [使用说明.md](使用说明.md)**——按"照着做"的口径编写，含换电脑完整流程、回退步骤和常见问题。本文档偏设计与实现。

## 它解决什么问题

换电脑时，DSH 的环境散落在很多地方：profile 里装了哪些插件、每个插件的版本、`cordis.patch.yml` 里的配置覆盖、插件自己写的数据、全局工作区设置……手工搬极易漏项，而**漏掉一处就可能让新电脑上的 DSH 起不来**。

这个插件把这些收拢成一个文件，并保证还原过程可预览、可回退。

## 核心设计取舍

| 决策 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **不备份 `node_modules`** | 插件本体有几百 MB，且完全可由 `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` 复现。归档只记录版本，还原时重装，新电脑得到的是干净正确的依赖树。 |
| **不备份运行时/Electron/日志/缓存** | 这些属于机器而非用户，是可重建的。把 Windows 运行时拷到新装环境正是"还原把好环境弄坏"的典型原因。 |
| **凭据默认不含，且永不明文** | `.credentials.yaml` 和 `workbuddy-vault/` 里是 API key 和登录 token。归档是会被拷到 U 盘和网盘的文件，**默认排除**；显式要求时用 AES-256-GCM 加密成独立成员。 |
| **还原默认只预览** | 写入前必须先看到"会改哪些文件、会增删哪些插件"。加 `apply: true` 才真正执行。 |
| **应用前自动做还原点** | 每次写入前把当前 profile 配置快照到带时间戳的目录，误操作可退回。 |
| **目标有额外插件时拒绝执行** | 避免"同步一次，把本机独有的插件配置弄丢"。需显式 `overwritePlugins: true`。 |

## 安装

插件目录：`D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync`

```powershell
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync
```

装完需要**重启 DSH** 才会注册工具。

> 该命令要写 `C:\Users\ThinkPad\.dsh\profiles\desktop`（在工作区之外），在受限沙箱下会报 EPERM，需要一次完全权限。

## 用法

### 在 DSH 会话里（推荐）

装好后直接对 agent 说，例如：

- 「看看我这台电脑现在有哪些插件和设置」→ `dsh_config_status`
- 「把插件和设置备份出来」→ `backup_dsh_config`
- 「把这个备份还原到新电脑」→ `restore_dsh_config`

五个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_config_status` | 看现状：装了哪些插件、各类设置文件数量、备份会包含什么 |
| `backup_dsh_config` | 生成备份归档（支持 `dryRun` 预览） |
| `restore_dsh_config` | 预览/应用还原 |
| `verify_dsh_config` | 校验归档完整性（逐个成员核对 sha256） |
| `list_dsh_backups` | 列出已有归档 |

### 命令行（DSH 起不来时用这个）

```powershell
$cli = "D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"   # 仅用于装插件
node D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync\bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs <命令>
```

```powershell
# 看现状
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs status

# 备份（默认不含凭据和会话）
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\backup\dsh.zip

# 备份并加密包含登录凭据
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\backup\dsh.zip `
     --categories profile-config,home-config,plugin-state,credentials --password 你的口令

# 校验
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs verify --input D:\backup\dsh.zip

# 还原：默认只预览
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\backup\dsh.zip --profile desktop

# 确认后真正写入
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\backup\dsh.zip --profile desktop --apply
```

## 换电脑的完整流程

**旧电脑**

```powershell
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\dsh-backup.zip
```

**新电脑**（先装好 DSH 本体）

```powershell
# 1. 校验归档，确认传输没损坏
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs verify --input D:\dsh-backup.zip

# 2. 预览：看清楚会写入什么、插件增删情况
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\dsh-backup.zip --profile desktop

# 3. 应用
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\dsh-backup.zip --profile desktop --apply
```

**4. 安装插件**（归档不含 `node_modules`，第 3 步会打印完整命令）

```powershell
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-pet@0.3.7
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mnemon@0.5.29
# …按第 3 步输出的清单逐个装
```

**5. 重启 DSH。**

## 备份类别

| 类别 | 默认 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `profile-config` | ✅ | `package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml`、`cordis.yml`、`cordis.patch.yml` 等 |
| `home-config` | ✅ | `storages/workspace.json`、`telemetry/` 等全局设置 |
| `plugin-state` | ✅ | 各插件在 `DSH_HOME` 下的状态目录 |
| `credentials` | ❌ | 登录凭据，需 `password`，AES-256-GCM 加密 |
| `sessions` | ❌ | 会话记录，体积大 |

## 安全说明

- 明文凭据**从不**进入归档。代码里有一条独立防线：任何成员名命中凭据模式都会直接报错中止，而不是默默写进去。
- `workbuddy-vault/` 存的是明文 token，它在 `plugin-state` 里会被自动排除并给出提示——这是实测发现的真实风险点。
- 加密用 scrypt（N=2¹⁵）派生密钥 + AES-256-GCM，口令错误或归档被篡改都会解密失败，不会还原出似是而非的内容。
- **忘记口令 = 凭据无法恢复**，需要在新电脑重新登录。

## 测试

```powershell
node --test test/          # 或直接：node test/sync.test.mjs
```

覆盖 ZIP 往返与损坏检测、加密往返与错误口令、清单排除规则、凭据隔离、预览不落盘、还原点、篡改检测和 CLI。

> 在受限沙箱里，涉及子进程的 4 个 CLI 用例会因 `spawn EPERM` 跳过——那是沙箱禁止管道 stdio，不是插件缺陷。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-config-sync/
├── bin/dsh-config-sync.mjs   # 独立 CLI（DSH 起不来时的救援通道）
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js              # 插件入口，注册 5 个工具
│   ├── inventory.js          # 决定备份什么（核心策略所在）
│   ├── archive.js            # 备份 / 预览 / 还原 / 校验
│   ├── crypto.js             # 口令加密
│   └── zip.js                # 零依赖 ZIP 读写
├── test/sync.test.mjs
└── cordis.patch.yml
```

零运行时依赖：ZIP 和加密都用 Node 内置模块实现，避免在"正在修环境"的机器上还要先装依赖。

plugins.description: DSH community plugin: ask any set of models to draw a pelican riding a bicycle on a schedule, then lay every drawing out on a read-only board. No scoring — the pictures are the result. Pausable, with a settable interval.
plugins.readme_text:
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

A DeepSeek Harness **community plugin** that runs a long-term
**model-quality probe** (降智监测) on a schedule, across **any number of
models**:

- **Pick your models** — the gear in the panel's top-right corner lists every model the
  configured providers report (live `/models` discovery, merged with the models
  in your DSH profile) and probes a multi-selected set, each model through its
  own provider and API key.
- **Scheduled drawing** — every 30 minutes (configurable) each selected model is
  asked to draw a *pelican riding a bicycle* as a single-file HTML page with an
  inline SVG.
- **No skills, no tools** — each run is a bare `chat/completions` request with
  no tool definitions and no agent loop, so the result measures the model
  alone, never your local skills.
- **Everything flat, nothing to click** — the main board is read-only: one band
  per model, its status and figures on the left (when its newest drawing landed,
  runs, average duration, how many came back without a drawing, and the failure
  reason) and every drawing it ever made on the right, all laid out at once —
  nothing collapsed, filtered, or hidden behind a click.
- **Run state in the header** — while probing: “n/m done”, which models are in
  flight, how long the slowest has waited (m:ss) and the timeout cap (m:ss), so a
  slow model and a stuck one are told apart at a glance.
- **One gear button** — the panel's own top-right corner opens a settings sheet:
  pick models, probe now, open one drawing's original page. The board below stays
  pure viewing, so nothing has to be clicked to be read.
- **Stop it, retune it** — that same sheet can **pause / resume automatic
  probing**, change the **interval** (1–1440 minutes), and **stop the pass that is
  running right now**: requests in flight are aborted, models that had not started
  are skipped without a request being sent. Pausing is written to
  `settings.json` immediately and survives a restart, so a plugin you only probe
  by hand never costs a token on its own.
- **Bounded history** — keeps the newest N drawings (12 by default), pruning
  older ones automatically. Same prompt, same model, over days: degradation
  shows up as worse structure, refusals (saved and badged 「未检出 SVG」), or
  latency growth.

## Install

From this GitHub repository (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch.git
```

Or from a local path or tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pelican-watch
```

Note: `link:`-installed plugins are not watched by HMR, so editing
`lib/index.js` or `lib/client.js` requires an app restart to take effect.

## Choosing models

The gear in the panel's top-right corner opens the settings sheet: every provider found in your DSH profiles, with
the models it serves (its own `/models` endpoint, merged with whatever the
profile already lists). Tick any number of models and **Save models** — from the next
cycle on each selected model draws its own picture and gets its own band on the
board.

That selection lives in `dir/settings.json` and is what the scheduler uses;
`config.model` / `config.targets` only seed the first run. The same file holds
two knobs that decide what you spend, both changeable from the panel's gear
without touching any config file:

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoEnabled` | `true` | Off disarms the timer at once (`nextRunAt` goes empty); only the manual “probe now” then spends anything, and the choice survives a restart. |
| `intervalMinutes` | follows `config.intervalMinutes` (30) | Changing it in the panel re-arms the countdown immediately — no restart. |
`config.model` / `config.targets` only seed the very first run. At most 12
models are probed per cycle — `concurrency` of them at the same time (3 by
default), one drawing each.

## Speed and timeouts

- **Models run in parallel** (3 at a time by default), so one slow model no
  longer delays the others: every drawing is written to disk the moment it
  arrives and shows up in the panel within seconds.
- **Each request has its own timeout** (`timeoutSeconds`, default 180). A model
  that exceeds it is reported as `超过 N 秒没有返回` on its own band instead of
  hanging the whole pass. Reasoning models can genuinely be slow — measured
  against one provider: `qwen3.7-max` ~52s, `deepseek-flash` ~121s (15k of those
  completion tokens were reasoning), while `glm-5.3-flash` sometimes exceeded
  4 minutes.
- **A timeout or HTTP error is not a drawing**: nothing is saved and it does not
  count as a drawing, because that is an infrastructure fact rather than model
  behaviour. A model that *answers* without an SVG (a refusal) is saved and
  marked `没出图` — that is the signal worth looking at.
- `maxTokens` is not sent by default: reasoning models spend tens of thousands of
  completion tokens before they draw, and a tight ceiling would truncate the SVG
  instead of speeding anything up.

## Configuration

Defaults match the usual profile setup; override any of them on a
`pelican-watch` row in your profile patch (`cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: pelican-watch
  config:
    model: glm-5.3-flash                 # seed model (the panel's selection wins)
    baseURL: https://taotoken.net/api/v1 # OpenAI-compatible endpoint
    apiKeyEnv: TAOTOKEN_API_KEY          # env var holding the API key…
    # apiKey: sk-…                       # …or put the key here directly
    # targets:                           # optional: seed several models at once
    #   - { provider: taotoken, baseURL: https://taotoken.net/api/v1, apiKeyEnv: TAOTOKEN_API_KEY, model: glm-5.3-flash }
    intervalMinutes: 30                  # drawing cadence
    maxImages: 12                        # history depth (per model ≈6h at 30min)
    timeoutSeconds: 180                  # per-request ceiling; raise it for slow models
    concurrency: 3                       # how many models are probed at once
    # maxTokens: 8192                    # optional; unset by default (see below)
    dir: ~/.dsh/pelican-watch            # where drawings are saved
    runOnStart: true                     # draw once ~8s after boot
    # temperature: 0.7                   # optional; omitted by default
    # prompt: …                          # only if you must change the benchmark
```

The benchmark prompt is deliberately fixed — changing it makes the history
incomparable, so treat `prompt` as a last resort.

## API key

The key is resolved at call time, in this order:

1. a literal `apiKey` in config;
2. `process.env[apiKeyEnv]` (default `TAOTOKEN_API_KEY`);
3. the same name in DSH's own credential store — `refs:` in
   `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (override the path with `credentialsFile`).

Step 3 is why a DSH-configured provider key works with no extra setup: the
desktop app is launched from Finder/Dock and therefore does **not** inherit
environment variables exported in a shell, while `refs:` already holds the key
under the provider's `apiKeyEnv` name.

With none of the three the run is skipped and the panel shows the reason
(`缺少 API Key：…`) — set any one of them and the next scheduled run proceeds.

## Display only — no scoring

This plugin **does not score anything**. It does two things: it asks every model
the same drawing prompt on a schedule, and it lays the drawings out as they are.

Earlier versions computed a 0-100 "structural score" offline (is there an SVG, two
wheels, a frame, wings…). That has been removed on request: such a number can
only approximate “did these elements appear”, and it lends a false precision.
The judgement is left to whoever looks at the pictures (or to a vision model):
**same prompt, same model, over consecutive days — the drawings themselves are
the finding**, and no digit has to stand in for them.

The numbers that remain on the board are not grades, just facts: how many runs,
average duration, when the newest drawing landed, and how many runs came back
without a drawing. `没有出图` means the request returned but carried no usable
SVG (typically a refusal); the raw answer

plugins.description: 轻量化的QoL插件，可在助手消息元数据行追加本轮 token 费用估算（¥）。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-costview | 轻量化QoL插件

本插件在助手消息的**元数据行**追加了 `¥x.xx` 的显示功能：
按 DSH 记录的每轮 token 用量和官方**高峰 / 空闲**两档单价，估算这一轮花了多少钱。

> 兼容性：在 DSH 桌面版 **0.2.1-rc.2** 可运行

## 效果

![效果](./screenshot.png)

- 金额统一**保留两位小数**（精确到「分」）。不足半分钱的用量会显示成 `¥0.00`；
- 注意：**数字以 DeepSeek 账单为准，此处为估算值**。

## 估算方式

- 单价只覆盖 `deepseek-flash`。assistant 节点的 `usage` 里不带模型名，
  换用 `deepseek-v4-pro` 等其他模型时金额是错的（会严重偏低）；
- 一轮对话若是跨过 `12:00` / `18:00` 这种档位边界，整轮会按**最后一次请求**的档位计价；
- 缓存写入官方没有单独定价，这里并入「缓存未命中输入」计算；
- 取不到单轮数据时会退回到**整会话累计**，那一条会明显偏大。

## 计费规则

高峰时段（北京时间）：**周一至周五**（不含中国法定节假日）`09:00–12:00`、`14:00–18:00`；
其余时段——**含周末与法定节假日全天**——都算空闲时段，空闲价恰好是高峰价的一半。

单价在 `client.js` 的 `RATE_CARD`（人民币 / 百万 tokens，deepseek-flash）：

| 项目 | 高峰时段 | 空闲时段 |
|---|---|---|
| 输入（缓存未命中） | 2.00 | 1.00 |
| 输入（缓存命中） | 0.04 | 0.02 |
| 输出 | 8.00 | 4.00 |

数值取自官方价目页 <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/>。
官方调价后请直接改 `client.js` 里的 `RATE_CARD`。

## 法定节假日（`/holiday`）

放假安排没法从时间戳推断，所以插件不内置任何节假日表：默认只按「周末 + 峰谷时段」判档。
需要精确到节假日时，在 Web 客户端的 `/` 菜单里跑一次 **`/holiday`**：

- 联网拉**去年 + 今年**两份（这样跨年的会话也有档位），把放假日写进
  `localStorage['dsh-costview:holidays']`，此后离线可用；
- 数据源是 [holiday-cn](https://github.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn)（每年一份静态 JSON，
  条目形如 `{ date, name, isOffDay }`），经 jsDelivr CDN 取；条目里的 `papers`
  指向国务院公告原文；
- 只把 `isOffDay: true` 的日期当放假日；**调休补班的周末按官方字面照旧算空闲时段**，
  不做特殊处理（也就是这些天上下午的用量仍按空闲价计）；
- 它是 `action` 类型的命令，点了就跑，**不产生任何会话 token**。结果是静默的 ——
  想知道拉没拉到，再敲一次 `/holiday` 看候选项那一行：未拉取时显示「当前未记录」，
  拉取后显示「已记录 2025/2026 年共 N 个放假日（YYYY-MM-DD 拉取）」；
- 拉取失败（断网 / CDN 不可用）会**保留已有记录**，只在 console 里写一条错误；
- 刷新成功后已渲染的金额会立刻重算。

> 想手工补某一天，也可以在 DevTools 里改
> `localStorage['dsh-costview:holidays']` 的 `offDays` 数组（北京时间 `'YYYY-MM-DD'`）。
> 注意插件只在首次用到时读一次，改完要 Ctrl+R 重载。

## 已知问题

- 只覆盖 `deepseek-flash`，换模型金额不准；
- 一轮跨峰谷边界时整轮按后一档计价；
- 没有悬浮框；token 明细与档位挂在元素上不可见的 `data-dsh-costview-*` 属性里
  （`tier` / `uncached` / `cache-read` / `cache-write` / `output`），排查时在 DevTools 里看；
- 部分插件的安装卸载过程可能会导致本插件的 GUI 界面暂时失效，重启即可。

## 安装 / 卸载

不发布到 npm。两种装法任选其一。

### 方式一：直接从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

```powershell
# <DSH 安装目录> = DeepSeek Harness 的安装位置，dsh.cmd 在其 resources\runtime\cli\bin\ 下
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop add github:Yulu224/dsh-costview
```

### 方式二：clone 后挂载本地目录

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Yulu224/dsh-costview.git
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop add '<克隆目录>'
```

### 卸载

```powershell
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-costview
```

plugins.description: Live per-session cost badge for DeepSeek Harness (top-right), with peak/off-peak (time-of-day) pricing.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-cost-meter

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-cost-meter)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-cost-meter)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2ea44f)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts a **live cost badge in the conversation header (top-right)** and prices every request with **peak / off-peak (time-of-day) tiers**.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Session title                                [¥0.0042]      │   ← badge here
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  … conversation …                                            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Features

- **Live** — the badge updates as the host reports provider usage; no polling, no timers.
- **Historically correct** — each request is priced by its **own wall-clock timestamp**, so a session that spans peak and off-peak stays accurate even if the page sits open overnight.
- **Weekday-aware peak tiers** — DeepSeek bills peak only **Monday–Friday**; weekends are off-peak all day. The schedule is configurable (windows, weekdays, multiplier, time zone).
- **Silent price sync** — a bundled price catalog plus an out-of-band remote catalog refreshed on an interval. Push a new `catalog/prices.json` and every installed copy picks it up **without a plugin release**; a failed refresh keeps the last good rates.
- **Explicit peak/off-peak rates** — models may carry an explicit discounted pair (`cacheMiss` + `cacheMissOffPeak`), not just a multiplier.
- **Route-aware matching** — `provider/model`, `provider/*`, `*`-model wildcards, and case/space/punctuation-insensitive model ids.
- **Never fakes a number** — an unpriced route renders `未配置` (`unpriced`) instead of a made-up fallback rate.

## Install

### From npm (recommended)

```cmd
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-cost-meter
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` activates it as a profile layer automatically — no manual `cordis.patch.yml` row is required.

### From a local checkout

```cmd
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:E:/path/to/dsh-plugin-cost-meter"
```

`link:` keeps the checkout live, so edits apply after a `dsh web` restart without reinstalling.

Restart the server afterwards:

```cmd
dsh web
```

## Configure

The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row with defaults. Override it by adding a `cost-meter` row with the same `id` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: cost-meter
      name: dsh-plugin-cost-meter
      config:
        currency: CNY                 # display currency; empty = catalog currency
        fx:
          cnyPerUsd: 7.1              # used when the catalog is USD and you display CNY
        catalogUrl: ""                # "" = this package's own catalog (derived from repository)
        refreshMinutes: 360           # silent refresh interval; 0 disables it
        pricingTimeoutMs: 4000
        pricingUrl: ""                # optional legacy { models, default } document
        models:                       # manual overrides (highest priority, display currency)
          deepseek-official/deepseek-flash:
            inputPerM: 1.06           # off-peak base
            cacheReadPerM: 0.021
            cacheWritePerM: 1.06
            outputPerM: 4.26
        default:                      # optional fallback; omit to report unknown routes as unpriced
          inputPerM: 1
          outputPerM: 4
        peak:
          enabled: true
          multiplier: 2               # used only when a rate has no explicit off-peak value
          timezoneOffsetMinutes: 480  # UTC+8
          days: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]       # ISO weekdays; weekends are off-peak
          windows: [[9, 12], [14, 18]]
```

Two rate styles are accepted everywhere:

- **Catalog style** (peak base + optional off-peak): `cacheMiss`, `cacheHit`, `cacheWrite`, `output`, and `cacheMissOffPeak`, `cacheHitOffPeak`, `cacheWriteOffPeak`, `outputOffPeak`.
- **Legacy style** (off-peak base): `inputPerM`, `cacheReadPerM`, `cacheWritePerM`, `outputPerM` (with optional `*Peak` fields).

## Automatic price updates

Prices resolve in this order (highest wins):

1. `config.models` / `config.default`
2. `config.pricingUrl` (legacy document)
3. the **remote catalog** at `config.catalogUrl` — default: this package's own `catalog/prices.json` on GitHub, derived from `package.json.repository`
4. the **bundled** `catalog/prices.json` (offline fallback)

A timer re-reads the remote catalog and `pricingUrl` every `refreshMinutes` (default 6 hours) and swaps the live table in place:

- a failed refresh **keeps the last successful data**;
- a source that never loaded does not clear anything;
- a price change applies to the whole session on the **next event**, and immediately on a page reload.

This makes the catalog the single place to maintain rates: **edit and push `catalog/prices.json`, and installed copies update themselves** — no new plugin release. Forks get their own update channel automatically because the default URL is derived from `package.json.repository`.

To point at a private mirror or a local file, set `catalogUrl` (`https://…`, a path, or `file:///…`). Set it to `""` to disable remote syncing.

## Peak / off-peak

- Tiering uses the **request's own `event.time`**, never "now".
- Peak applies only on the configured weekdays (`days`, default Monday–Friday); weekends are off-peak all day.
- The schedule comes from the catalog's `peakSchedule` (time zone, days, windows, off-peak ratio) and can be overridden field by field in `config.peak`.
- `peak.enabled: false` bills one flat rate; `peak.timezoneOffsetMinutes` shifts the wall clock for the window check.

The hover tooltip shows the current tier, the multiplier, the route, and the token breakdown.

## Pricing model

```
cost = Σ_routes [ cost_off(route) + cost_peak(route) ]

cost_tier(route) = (uncachedInput × miss
                  + cacheRead     × hit
                  + cacheWrite    × write
                  + output        × out) / 1_000_000
```

Totals are accumulated per `{ provider, model }` route and per tier, so switching models mid-session keeps each route on its own price. A repeated usage sample for the same `(turn, step)` replaces the earlier one instead of double-counting.

## Compatibility

| Surface | DSH ≤ 0.1.0-rc.6 | DSH ≥ 0.1.5 |
|---|---|---|
| Projection contract | `schema` + `view` | `stateSchema` + `wire: { viewSchema, view }` |
| Client deps | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session` |
| Compatibility gate | — | `engines.dsh` / `peerDependencies` must satisfy the running version |

The badge uses the additive `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot; `…header.corner` is a `single` slot already occupied by a shipped plugin.

## Development

```cmd
npm install
npm test
```

`test/contract.test.mjs` covers the projection contract, weekday peak, catalog parsing, explicit dual rates, currency conversion, normalization/wildcards, unpriced routes, and manual overrides. It runs offline (`catalogUrl: ""`).

## Notes

- Costs are **estimates**: they depend on the provider-reported `usage` and on the price table.
- The badge is **per session**; it does not aggregate sub-sessions or the whole account.
- The bundled catalog is a dated snapshot — verify it against the [official pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) and update `catalog/prices.json` when rates change.
- The plugin is a Web surface plugin; compositions without `sessionProjections` (e.g. headless) skip registration.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Opt-in per-conversation Markdown study notes and automatic index management for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-study-note

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns explicitly opted-in conversations into structured Markdown study notes. Each conversation starts with recording off; enabling one conversation does not enable another.

## Quick start — tutorial

Requires Node.js 22.19+ and a DSH profile providing `commands`, `sessions`, and `llm`. Loader composition is tested against the installed DSH 0.1.0-rc.8 and the local 0.1.1-rc.2 build. Later releases are not yet verified. The package contains executable JavaScript and needs no install-time build.

1. Clone the plugin, install development dependencies, and create an installable archive:

   ```sh
   git clone https://github.com/WaterFountain-Jack/dsh-study-note.git
   cd dsh-study-note
   npm install
   npm pack
   ```

2. Install into your intended profile. This changes that profile; replace `desktop` if yours has another name. This package is not published to npm, so installing by npm name will not work.

   ```sh
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add "$PWD/dsh-study-note-0.1.0.tgz"
   dsh --profile desktop --dump-config
   ```

3. Restart that DSH profile if it has not hot-loaded the plugin. In a conversation, run the commands below as separate messages, then ask a learning question and let the assistant finish its answer:

   ```text
   /note on Cordis
   /note status
   ```

4. Recording runs in the background after a complete answer. `/note sync` checks all completed eligible turns immediately and retries pending failures; `/note status` reports the file and latest error. Verify the generated document and root index in the configured notes directory. Disable this conversation with `/note off`.

Uninstalling preserves notes and local state:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-study-note
```

## Conversation controls — reference

| Command | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `/note on [topic]` | Enable this conversation; process only complete turns that begin after enabling. Repeating it does not reset the checkpoint. |
| `/note off` | Cancel and await background work, retain existing files. After success no new automatic writes occur for this conversation. |
| `/note status` | Show switch, directory, topic, file, pending work, and latest error. |
| `/note sync` | Process eligible completed turns now; requires recording on. Does not backfill the off interval. |
| `/note topic <topic>` | Pin a topic and move this conversation's existing note; rebuild the index. |
| `/note reindex` | Rebuild the plugin-owned root index, without a model call; also available while off. |
| `/note new` | Clear the association only after the old note is deleted or moved outside the root; leaves recording off. Use `on` for a fresh start without historical backfill. |

Topics contain 1–64 letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. A pinned topic can create a directory; automatic topic selection only uses existing directories, falling back to `inbox`. Subagent conversations cannot opt in.

## Notes and index — reference

```text
~/.dsh/study-notes/
├── README.md
├── Cordis/
│   └── 2026-10-15-Cordis-学习-<session-hash>.md
├── inbox/
└── .study-note/
    ├── state.json
    ├── writer.lock
    └── requests/
```

One document belongs to one conversation. A relevant question creates a section containing the question, one-line conclusion, explanation, formula/code/example, an AI-drafted understanding for you to rewrite, unresolved questions, and source turn/event numbers. Follow-ups can update an existing section; unrelated questions add sections. Notes do not certify correctness or mastery.

Hand-edited sections are not replaced: related follow-ups append a supplemental section instead. Preserve the HTML metadata and section markers. Renames and moves within the root are discovered on the next write or `/note reindex`; external edits are not watched continuously. Deleting a note does not silently recreate it. Keep one copy per conversation inside the root.

Only the region between `<!-- dsh-study-note:index:start -->` and `<!-- dsh-study-note:index:end -->` is maintained in `README.md`. Handwritten entries outside that region stay unchanged. Only this plugin's documents join its index; existing unrelated notes are not rewritten or automatically cataloged.

## Configuration — reference

The bundle entry id is `study-note`. An optional overlay selects a different root:

```yaml
- id: study-note
  config:
    notesDir: '~/study-notes'
```

Save the overlay at a path you choose and pass `--patch <absolute-overlay-path>` when launching the profile. Alternatively merge the entry into your profile patch, preserving other entries. This project does not change your active profile or existing knowledge base.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notesDir` | `~/.dsh/study-notes` | Absolute path or `~/` path; choose a separate directory for each simultaneous DSH process. |
| `debounceMs` | `1500` | Delay after a completed turn before background processing. |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Auxiliary request deadline, including its audit write. |
| `provider`, `model` | absent | Supply both non-empty strings to override; otherwise reuse the completed answer's route. |
| `maxInputBytes` | `98304` | UTF-8 limit for the entire framed auxiliary request; oversize fails visibly. |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `65536` | Limit for serialized stream chunks, not only final text. |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `4000` | Auxiliary output-token cap. |
| `recentSections` | `6` | Most recent note sections supplied as follow-up context. |
| `maxMessageChars` | `12000` | Per question, answer, or section text limit; truncation is explicitly marked. |

## Privacy, cost, and failures — reference

Never-enabled conversations produce no recording files or auxiliary model calls. Recording selects human-origin text and the last complete assistant text from future completed turns; it excludes reasoning blocks, tool results, images, injected user messages, and interrupted output. Exact routine acknowledgements and progress questions are filtered locally; other irrelevant turns may still require a model call to decide to skip.

Each eligible turn can cause an additional paid request to the configured provider, including skipped content. Only one request runs at a time per conversation; different conversations may run concurrently. Prior note sections, including your edits in those sections, can enter these requests. The plugin does not read API keys or ambient environment values, but does not redact secrets that you typed into conversation text. Do not enable it for sensitive conversations unless that provider and local retention are acceptable.

Before dispatch, the exact system prompt, messages, route, token limit, and source event numbers are written to `.study-note/requests/`. These local audit files retain selected conversation text even if the model skips the turn or recording is then disabled. New files use owner-only permissions; they are not encrypted and existing parent permissions are not tightened. Disabling or uninstalling does not erase files; there is no automatic retention cleanup.

The auxiliary request is not inserted into the main model history or DSH session log. The tested host cannot safely register external informational session events, so replay requires keeping the plugin audit directory alongside the DSH conversation log. No shell command or model tool executes during recording.

Model errors, invalid JSON, truncation finishes, missing files, malformed markers, and permissions errors are reported by `/note status` and runtime logs. Fix the cause and use `/note sync`; failed model work may be billed again on retry. Note, state, and index are separate atomic file replacements, not one transaction; an index failure may leave a saved note, and sync rebuilds without regenerating that committed turn. A crash can cause duplicate model billing but note metadata prevents duplicate committed sections on recovery. Filesystem rename durability across sudden power loss is not guaranteed.

Only one writer may hold a notes directory. A crash may leave `.study-note/writer

# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-env-audit

**在你把密钥提交进 git 之前，先看一眼 `.env` 本身。**

**关键词**：配置文件审计 · .env 检查 · 密钥进 git · 文件权限 · 明文密码 · gitignore · 环境变量 · .env.example · 配置与代码分离

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**是**：只盯**环境配置文件本身**的四件事 —— 会不会被提交、权限宽不宽、里面是不是明文、有没有模板。

**不是**：
- ❌ **不是密钥扫描器** —— 扫**代码里的密钥字面量**（`sk-...`、AKIA...）是 `dsh-secret-scan` 的活
- ❌ **不是密钥管理工具** —— 它不存密钥、不轮换、不加密
- ❌ **不是运行时防护** —— 不拦读取，只做静态审计
- ❌ **不下「安全 / 不安全」的结论** —— 只描述事实，判断留给你

**一句话分界**：
```
secret-scan = 代码里有没有写死密钥
env-audit   = 配置文件本身有没有把密钥暴露出去
```

---

## 它查什么（5 条）

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `ENV-NOT-IGNORED` | `.gitignore` / `.git/info/exclude` 里没有忽略 `.env`，而项目里有凭据型环境配置 | 🔴 |
| `ENV-PLAINTEXT` | `.env` 里 `PASSWORD=` / `SECRET=` / `TOKEN=` / `API_KEY=` 跟的是明文而非占位符 | 🔴 |
| `ENV-FILE-PERM` | `.env` 权限宽于 `600`（同机器其他用户可读）| 🟡 |
| `ENV-NO-EXAMPLE` | 有环境配置内容，却找不到 `.env.example` / `.env.sample` 模板 | 🔵 |
| `ENV-HARDCODED-CONFIG` | 源码里硬编码内网/私有网段地址或 `.internal` 主机名 | 🔵 |

**每条都会给出：哪个文件、第几行、证据、依据（可查证的标准/文档）、以及怎么办。**

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-env-audit
```

## 用法

```bash
# 审计当前目录
dsh-env-audit

# 审计指定目录
dsh-env-audit --root /path/to/project

# 看内置演示（一个「.env 没忽略 + 644 + 明文密码 + 没有模板」的项目）
dsh-env-audit --demo

# 列出规则与依据
dsh-env-audit --list-rules

# 出 HTML 报告（可截图归档）
dsh-env-audit --root . --html env-audit.html

# 挂 CI：有 high 命中时退出码 1
dsh-env-audit --quiet --json
```

---

## 一个真实的例子

`--demo` 那个样本项目的一切看起来都很正常：有 `package.json`、有 `src/`、有 `.gitignore`。

`dsh-env-audit` 看见的：

```
🔴 .gitignore 没忽略 .env，且有凭据型环境配置            .gitignore
🔴 .env 明文：DB_PASSWORD=      （报告只到等号为止）   .env:10
🔴 .env 明文：STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=                      .env:14
🔴 .env 明文：JWT_SECRET=                             .env:15
🔴 .env 明文：SMTP_PASSWORD=                          .env:16
🟡 .env 权限 644 超过上限 600                          .env
🔵 有凭据型环境配置，却找不到 .env.example 模板         .env.example
🔵 源码硬编码内网地址 10.0.3.12                        src/db.js:4
```

**这 8 条，`git add .` 之前就能看见。**

---

## 关于「明文」这条规则的两个设计取舍

1. **报告里不会出现你的密钥值。** 正则只吃到 `KEY=` 为止，值是用零宽断言「验证存在」的 —— 所以证据栏永远是 `DB_PASSWORD=` 这个样子。工具自己不能变成泄露源。
2. **占位符不算。** `空值`、`${DB_PASSWORD}`、`<generate-with-openssl-rand>`、`your_xxx`、`changeme`、`xxx`、`test`、`example` 这类写法会被跳过。

## 边界（说清楚做不到什么）

- **不知道 `.env` 是不是「已经」提交过** —— 核心引擎是离线文件扫描，不读 git 索引。规则报的是「当前 `.gitignore` 没忽略它」，以及「忽略它不等于已提交的历史被清掉」。已提交过的情况请用 `git log --all -- .env` 自查。
- **权限规则只在 POSIX（Linux/macOS）上有意义** —— Windows 没有这套权限位；若在 Windows 上跑，`600` 的比较结果不可用。
- **`ENV-NOT-IGNORED` 和 `ENV-NO-EXAMPLE` 有「适用门槛」** —— 引擎的 `when` 门槛是「某处存在形如 `...PASSWORD=` / `SECRET=` / `TOKEN=` / `API_KEY=` / `CREDENTIAL=` 的赋值行」。带来两个后果：
  - 只写小写键名、或只含 `NODE_ENV` / `PORT` 这类无凭据项的环境文件，**不会**触发这两条（报告里会标为「因不适用未运行」）
  - 非 `.env` 的配置文件（`.ini`、`.properties` 等）里出现同形状的凭据赋值时，**也会**触发 —— 因为 `when` 门槛看不到文件名。此时标题只陈述「没有忽略 .env」和「有凭据型环境配置」两个事实，不宣称 `.env` 一定存在
- **明文规则只认常见的高危键名**（PASSWORD / PASSWD / SECRET / TOKEN / API_KEY / ACCESS_KEY / PRIVATE_KEY / CREDENTIAL）—— 自定义键名（如 `FOO=真实密钥`）不报。
- **`ENV-NOT-IGNORED` 是「整仓库任一 `.gitignore` 忽略了 `.env` 就算过」** —— 语义是「仓库里有没有忽略 .env 的地方」。这符合 gitignore 可叠加的实际行为；代价是：多包仓库里如果只有某一个子目录的 `.gitignore` 写了 `.env`，就不会报（单一根 `.gitignore` 的项目不受影响）。
- **只看 `.env` 系列文件** —— `config.json`、`settings.yaml` 里的明文凭据不归它管。
- **硬编码地址规则是低优先提示** —— 内网地址写在代码里不一定有问题，它只是违反「配置与代码分离」，报出来让你确认。

## 依据

每条规则的 `source` 都能查到原文：

- [OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Secrets_Management_Cheat_Sheet.html) —— 凭据不应进入版本控制；密钥应对最小范围可读；要让使用者清楚需要哪些配置项
- [The Twelve-Factor App · III. Config](https://12factor.net/config) —— 「配置与代码严格分离」，并明确指出配置文件「很容易被误提交进仓库」
- [Git · gitignore 官方文档](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitignore) —— 用 `.gitignore` 声明哪些文件不纳入版本控制

---


---

# dsh-plugin-auto-compact

> 上下文占用到 **50%** 就自动压缩 —— DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。
> Auto-compact a DSH session at **50%** context usage.

[![CI](https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

---

## 1. 这个插件干什么

把 DSH 的自动压缩阈值从出厂 **80%** 改成 **50%**，而且**四处一起改**：宿主平面一行 + `standard` / `cordis` / `ptc` 三个会话预设各一行（会话真正跑的是预设里 `isolate` 出来的独立实例，只改宿主那一行不起作用）。

装完「插件」页会多一张卡片「**上下文自动压缩**」，可开关、可卸载。

- 256K 窗口 ⇒ 约 **131k token** 触发压缩（出厂约 188k）
- 压缩引擎是 DSH 内置的，本插件只决定"以什么参数启用它"

## 2. 为什么需要它（痛点）

> 几个会话同时开着，其中一个**在我还没来得及压缩**的时候就跑满了 —— 窗口继续不了，只能**再开一个新窗口**。
> 可新窗口不知道旧窗口发生过什么：项目背景、试过的方案、刚跑通的命令、你上次纠正我的地方，全都没了。
> 只好把同样的上下文再交代一遍、命令再跑一遍，**重复的输入和重复的工具调用还要重新计费**。

根因：DSH 的自动压缩**只在"步骤边界"检查**（`agent/pre-step`，每个步骤开始前量一次），而一个重步骤
（批量读文件、长命令输出、大 diff）能在单步之内把余量吃光 —— 80% 的阈值常常来不及救。降到 50%，
就是永远给"一个重步骤"留出整块空间。

详细复盘与讨论 → **[Issue #1](https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact/issues/1)**（欢迎补充你的场景）

## 3. 怎么用

### 安装

「**插件 → + 添加插件**」→ 填下面任意一种 → 安装 → **重启 DSH**（档案补丁不热重载）：

| 填什么 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `github:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact` | 仓库地址，需要能访问 GitHub |
| 克隆下来的**绝对路径** | 任何网络都能用：`git clone https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact.git`（https 被重置时改用 `git clone git@github.com:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact.git`） |

重启后「插件 → **已安装**」出现卡片即成功。**关掉卡片开关 = 回到 DSH 出厂默认（80%）**，卸载则连同依赖一起移除。

### 验证（可选，推荐）

```bash
npm test            # 8 项结构自检，零依赖，裸 clone 就能跑
npm run preflight   # 用 DSH 自己的 loader 组合 profile，确认本插件的层赢了
```

> 你的 DSH 版本和作者的不同？先跑 `npm run regen` 再 preflight，让预设覆盖从你自己本机的 DSH 重新生成。

手动登记到 profile、给别人安装、升级 DSH 之后怎么同步、兼容性说明 —— 都在 [**docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md**](./docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md)。

## License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。`cordis.patch.yml` 里三段预设声明整份复制自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`（MIT，© DeepSeek）。

---

## English

- **What it does**: turns DSH's built-in context compaction on at **50%** instead of the shipped 80% — on the host plane *and* inside the `standard` / `cordis` / `ptc` presets, because a session actually runs the preset's isolated engine. A card appears on the Plugins page; switch it off to return to stock behaviour.
- **Why it exists**: DSH checks usage only at *step boundaries* (`agent/pre-step`), so one heavy step — bulk file reads, a long command output, a big diff — can fill the window before compaction fires. You then open a fresh session with no memory of the old one, re-explain everything, and pay for every repeated input and tool call again. Compacting at 50% always leaves a full heavy step of room. Full write-up: [Issue #1](https://github.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact/issues/1).
- **How to use**: Plugins → *Add plugin* → `github:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-auto-compact`, or clone the repo and paste the local path → restart DSH. Verify with `npm test` / `npm run preflight`; run `npm run regen` first if your DSH version differs.
- More detail: [docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md](./docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md). License: MIT.

# dsh-pdf-render

**一句话**：把 PDF 的指定页渲染成 PNG——**让模型亲眼看见**版式、表格与图表，而不是只读文本层。 **为什么值得用**：PDF 的文本层常常丢版式（多栏被读成一行、表格错位、图表完全丢失）。把页面渲染成图再走多模态读图，是「**亲眼看**」而不是「听转述」。本机没有 poppler / ghostscript，所以走已装的 `pypdfium2`——**依赖少一个是一个**。 ## 工具 - `pdf_render`：把 PDF 的指定页渲染为 PNG 并返回文件路径（不返回像素：看图请用 read_image / vision_ask）。pages 支持 1 / 1-3 / 2,5 / all。 ## 生态契约 > 依据《DSH 插件生态倡议书》三条原则：**组合优先 / 声明清晰 / 兼容优先**。 - **依赖 service**（`inject`）：`tools` —— 组合行装载时等待这些 service - **贡献面**：工具 `pdf_render`；slot 无；service 无 - 组合行 id：`agent-pdf-render` - **Fabric manifest**：`dsh-plugin.json`（RFC 0001 v0.1 **Draft** 形状）——`id` = `com.jonah791.pdf-render`，required = （无），optional = （无） - **Fabric 入口**：`src/fabric.ts` → `lib/fabric.js`（骨架，**不依赖 DSH/Cordis**；Fabric SDK 发布后填充实现） > ⚠ **不是认证**：Fabric 目前只有文档草案（无正式 schema、无 SDK、无 conformance 套件），因此**不得**声称本插件 > 「通过 Fabric 认证」或「已符合 Fabric 标准」。对齐的是 RFC 0001 的 manifest 形状 + 可机械校验的明文规则； > `dsh-plugin.json` 的 `$schema` 是**自证 draft 的占位**，Phase 0 发布 canonical identifier 后替换。 组合片段（`cordis.patch.yml`）： ```yaml - insert: - id: agent-pdf-render name: dsh-pdf-render config: {} ``` ## 能力边界（诚实声明） 本插件与宿主**同进程、全权限**运行。「能力声明」用于兼容判断、用户确认与审计，**不构成安全沙箱**——不要把它当权限边界。 本插件不导入其他插件或宿主的内部路径（组合优先），也不覆盖别人的内部实现。 ### 两个面，别混淆 - **Fabric 契约面**：`dsh-plugin.json` + `src/fabric.ts`（host entrypoint）。这是**前瞻声明**——Fabric 目前只有 RFC Draft， 没有正式 schema / SDK / conformance 套件，官方 `docs/plugin-development.md` 明示其**尚不能作为依赖或发布目标**； `$schema` 是自证 draft 的 `.invalid` 占位（RFC §14-1 未定 canonical identifier），**不是** schema 校验通过，也**不是**认证。 - **DSH/Cordis 面（非标准扩展路径）**：`src/index.ts` + `cordis.patch.yml`——本插件**现在真正可运行**的形态。 `tools` 不在 Fabric v0.1 的 capability 表内（v0.1 只有 host.info / log / 生命周期取消 + `storage.local` / `commands` / `messages.observe`）， 故这属标准之外的扩展路径：**不得**当作可移植 API，也**不得**成为 Fabric entrypoint 的依赖。 ## 构建与挂载 ```sh pnpm build # 挂载到 web profile（dsh plugin-manager 或 plugin_mount） ``` ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**： ```jsonc "dsh-pdf-render": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-pdf-render" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: agent-pdf-render name: dsh-pdf-render config: {} ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`pdf_render {path: "<某个 PDF>", pages: "1"}` → 应返回 **PNG 文件路径**（不是像素、不是 base64）；再用 `read_image` 打开它 → 应看见该页版式。 ## 配置 | 项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `outDir` | `$DSH_HOME/_tmp_review/pdf-render` | 渲染输出目录 | | `scale` | `1.5` | 渲染倍率（2.0 更清晰但文件更大） | ## 落盘与自证 | 文件 | 何时写 | 内容 | |---|---|---| | `/-p.png` | 每次 `pdf_render` | 该页的 PNG（返回的是**路径**） | **一条命令答五问**：`ls -la ` → ① 渲染产物在不在 ② 谁的（文件名含源 PDF 名）③ 哪一页（`-p`）④ 质量（文件大小与倍率）⑤ 时间（mtime）。 ## 生效判据与回退 **判据**：行为级——`pdf_render` 返回路径且该文件存在、能被 `read_image` 打开。 **回退**：① `git revert` + 重建 + 预检重启；② patch 行 `disabled: true`；③ 已渲染的 PNG 留在 `outDir`，可手工清理。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-pdf-render && npm test ``` **31 条用例**（跑一次得到）：覆盖 pages 解析（`1` / `1-3` / `2,5` / `all` 与非法输入）· 路径与输出命名 · **文件不存在 ⇒ 响亮失败**（不是空图）。无需网络。 ## 设计要点 - **只返回路径**：不返回像素、不返回 base64——看图是 `read_image` / `vision_ask` 的职责（**职责单一**，且避免把二进制塞进上下文）。 - **pages 解析是纯函数**：`src/range.ts` 无 IO，可离线单测（31 条里大半在这一层）。 - **走 pypdfium2 而非 pdftoppm**：本机没有 poppler / ghostscript——**依赖少一个是一个**。 ## 相关文档 - [`docs/semantic.md`](docs/semantic.md) —— **权威契约**（定位/反定位 · 验收表） - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)（本插件归 **感知层**） - 相关技能：`document-processing`（PDF/Word/Excel/PPT 的本机处理配方） ## License MIT © jonah791 --- 本插件属于**爱丽丝 DSH 自研插件生态**（[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life) · 73 个插件 · 8 个模块）：单一职责、独立仓库、独立可用。

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查询（来源 / 对比 / 主体） --- ## 快速开始 任选一种即可。**以 GitHub 为唯一安装来源**（`npx github:taxueseek/argo` 或 `install.sh` / `install.ps1`），当前推荐 **v2.9.4**。**请勿用 `npm install argo-search`**——npm registry 上那份是**非官方陈旧版 v1.0.1**（非本仓库维护，功能残缺、不随本项目更新）。本包 `package.json` 已设 `private: true` 防止误发布到 npm registry。 **零配置就能跑**：不配 API Key 时走免费引擎 + 本地 `local_*` 引擎；配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。 ### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） macOS / Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex" # 或下载后执行： # powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install.ps1 ``` 装到指定目录、并挂 Skill 入口： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh \ | bash -s -- --home "$HOME/.local/share/argo" --link "$HOME/.claude/skills/argo" ``` 验证： ```bash python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py "python asyncio error handling" --json python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py --list-engines ``` ### 方式二：MCP 不装包，直接用 GitHub（推荐 Agent 快速挂载） 需要 **Node.js 18+** 和 **Python 3.9+**，首次执行一次： ```bash pip3 install pyyaml ``` ```bash npx -y github:taxueseek/argo ``` 客户端配置示例（Claude Code / Cursor / Kimi 等）： ```json { "mcpServers": { "argo": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "github:taxueseek/argo"] } } } ``` ### DeepSeek Harness 一键插件（.dsh-plugin bundle） 在 DeepSeek Harness 里一行安装（两种装法）： ```bash # 装法 A：19 个 mcp__argo__* 工具（主包自带 bundle，与 MCP 全量相同） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo" # 装法 B：搜索工具 + wide_research 并行研究调度（子包） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo#main&path:packages/dsh-plugin" ``` 重启 `dsh web` 后生效。包结构见 `packages/dsh-plugin/`；同 id `mcp-argo` / `wide-research` 可在用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖。装法 B 的 `wide_research` 模块只存在于子包依赖树，主包 patch 不引用它，避免只装主包时 Cordis 解析失败。已在最新版 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 实测：三形态接入（原生一等工具 / web_search seam / wide_research）均可正常启用。 ### 依赖清单（通俗版） | 依赖 | 必需？ | 干什么用 | 不装会怎样 | |------|:------:|---------|-----------| | **PyYAML** | ✅ 必需 | 读配置文件 | 完全跑不起来，安装脚本会自动装 | | **curl_cffi** | ❌ 可选（v2.7.3 新增） | 模拟浏览器 TLS 指纹，过反爬站（Cloudflare 等） | 反爬站抓取成功率低一些，日常搜索无影响 | | **ddgs CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 本地免 key 搜索的 10 个后端引擎 | 少一批零成本本地搜索源，其余不受影响 | | **realtime-index CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 实时索引引擎（搜刚发布的内容） | 该引擎自动禁用，显式指定会回退通用引擎 | | **Chrome** | ❌ 可选 | 页面截图、JS 渲染页、登录态抓取 | 截图工具不可用，其余正常 | | **pdfplumber / PyMuPDF** | ❌ 可选 | PDF 提取 | argo_pdf 不可用，其余正常 | | **Playwright** | ❌ 可选 | 截图增强 | 截图工具回退 Chrome CDP，其余正常 | 安装脚本（install.sh）只自动装前两个；其余可选依赖按需 `pip install` 或 `brew install` 即可。 更稳、完全不依赖 Node 的写法：先装脚本（方式一），再指向本机 Py

plugins.description: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): all 15 Coding Plan models with per-model reasoning-effort control, generated from a single source and drift-checked weekly.
plugins.readme_text:
# @dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan

火山方舟 **Ark Coding Plan** 的 provider 路由，用于 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**。

**收录全部 15 个 Coding Plan 模型，每个模型可调思考强度，元数据对着线上端点实测。**

> Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness.

---

## 与已有方案的区别

| | 官方 `ark-plan-api` | 本包 |
|---|---|---|
| Coding Plan 模型 | 8 个 | **15 个** |
| 思考强度开关 | 无 | **每模型可调** |
| 清单维护 | 手写 | **单一数据源 + 每周漂移检测** |
| 元数据 | 未标注 | **实测 + 日期** |

官方缺的 7 个：`deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`kimi-k3`、`ark-code-latest`、`glm-5.3-flash`、
`doubao-seed-2.1-lite`、`doubao-seed-2.0-mini`、`kimi-k2.8-preview`。

---

## 前置条件

1. 已安装 DSH（0.2.0-rc 或更新）
2. 已开通**火山方舟 Coding Plan 订阅**并拿到 API Key

> ⚠️ 本包不含任何密钥。

---

## ⚠️ 装之前先看这一条

本包**整体替换** `llm-pi-ai` 这一行的 `config`（DSH 的 patch 语义是「整体替换、不深合并」）。

- **在设置页 / `settings.yaml` 里配过别的 provider** → 不受影响（那里是深合并）。
- **在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手写过 pi-ai provider** → 会被替换，请先合并：

  ```sh
  node scripts/merge.mjs ~/.dsh/profiles/<你的 profile>/cordis.patch.yml
  ```

  默认**只打印**结果；确认无误后加 `--write` 落盘（会先备份 `.bak-merge-<时间戳>`）。
  合并助手只做文本级插入，**你的注释会保留**；键冲突时保留你原来的值，不会静默覆盖。

---

## 安装

### 方式 1：命令行（从 GitHub）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:STLI69/coding-plan
```

### 方式 2：插件市场

在市场里搜索 `coding-plan`，点安装。

### 方式 3：本地目录

在 **设置 → 插件 → 安装 bundle** 里指向本包目录。

装完**重启 DSH**。

---

## 填入 API Key

打开 **设置 → 模型（Models）**，找到 `Ark Coding Plan`，点编辑填入 Key。
本包声明的凭据引用名是 `ARK_CODING_PLAN_CN_API_KEY`。

---

## 模型与实测数据

**实测日期：2026-10-16**（方法：`node scripts/probe.mjs`，对着线上端点逐个模型打真实请求）

| 模型 | maxTokens | 图片输入 | 思考档位 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `doubao-seed-2.1-pro` | 393216 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-2.1-lite` | 262144 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-2.1-turbo` | 262144 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-evolving` | 262144 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-lite` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-mini` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `glm-5.3` | 131072 | ❌ | low/high/max |
| `glm-5.3-flash` | 131072 | ✅ | low/high/max |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 393216 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `deepseek-v4-flash` | 393216 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 393216 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `minimax-m3` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `kimi-k2.8-preview` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `kimi-k3` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |
| `ark-code-latest` | 131072 | ✅ | off/low/high/max |

- `maxTokens` 的档位粒度是 65536 / 131072 / 262144 / 393216：表中是**被端点接受的最高档**。
- `glm-5.3` 与 `glm-5.3-flash` **没有 `off`**：这两个模型关掉思考会 HTTP 400，所以不提供该档位。
- 思考 token 计入输出用量，调高思考档位会显著推高 output 消耗。

### 诚实性说明

> 本包只发布能实测的东西。
>
> **实测的**：每个模型可达、被接受的 `maxTokens` 上限、是否接受图片输入 —— 方法见
> `scripts/probe.mjs`，日期见上表。
>
> **未实测的**：`contextWindow`。验证它需要发送超长 prompt，成本不可控，所以表中没有列出，
> 它在 `models.yml` 里只作为**声明值**存在。
>
> **故意不做的**：Agent Plan / 后付费 / BytePlus 路由。我们没有这些端点的 key，无法验证，
> 因此不写进描述 —— 把没验证过的路由写进去，是收录规则里最容易被退回的一件事。
>
> **怎么保持不过期**：`models.yml` 是唯一数据源，每周 GitHub Action 自动探测模型下架与新品上线
> （候选清单在 `watchlist.yml`，人工维护，不保证覆盖所有新模型）。

---

## 为什么只有一个 patch

DSH 的 patch 语义是「整体替换、不深合并」，所以本包只能**覆盖** `llm-pi-ai` 那一行。

早期版本试过「`insert` 一个同插件的第二行」，**已实测证伪**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 会
无条件把整套 catalog 注册进 `dsh-llm` 的**单例** configurable-provider 目录，第二个实例必然报：

```
llm-pi-ai-ark-coding (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai): LlmError:
  configurable provider "amazon-bedrock" is already declared
```

而 `dsh-base` 总是先挂一行 `llm-pi-ai`，所以第二行在任何机器（含全新 profile）都无法激活，
与 provider 名字是否重名无关。

---

## 维护者

```sh
npm ci                 # 装 devDependency（js-yaml）
npm test               # 跑测试
npm run check          # 断言 cordis.patch.yml 与 models.yml 同步
npm run generate       # 改完 models.yml 后重新生成

# 实测并把结果写回 models.yml（需 ARK_CODING_PLAN_CN_API_KEY）
node scripts/probe.mjs --write

# 探测 watchlist 里的候选模型是否已上线
node scripts/probe.mjs --watchlist
```

改模型请**只改 `models.yml`**，然后 `npm run generate`。`cordis.patch.yml` 是生成物。

---

## 许可

MIT

# 🛡️ dsh-permission-rules - **1024 store channel**: `npm i -g dsh1024` once, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules` (counts toward the [deepseek1024.com](https://deepseek1024.com) install ranking). [![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not.* [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-permission-rules.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)
--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**
