plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-discover-index

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Aggregates the live [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/) catalog into
**plugin market index format 1** — the JSON document the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH) Discover tab reads.

Published index: <https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/index.json>

> [!NOTE]
> **Requires a recent DSH, and it is used as a custom market.**
> This index is consumed by the experimental **Custom plugin markets** feature, not by
> DSH core. That feature first shipped in **DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4** (2026-10-15) and is
> carried by every 0.2.1 build since; an older DSH has no Discover tab and no way to add
> an index source. It is still marked experimental upstream, so it is off by default and
> you switch it on yourself — see [Using it in DSH Discover](#using-it-in-dsh-discover).
>
> Nothing here patches or extends DSH: this repository only publishes a JSON file, and
> DSH reads it once you point the feature at that URL.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This project is a conversion and aggregation source, not a security review.**
> Every entry in the index is third-party data republished from upstream. Nothing here
> audits, sandboxes, or endorses the plugins it lists. Installing a DSH plugin runs
> third-party code inside your harness; review the plugin's source before you install it.

## Status

Published and automated. The index URL above serves a live document, rebuilt daily by
[`build.yml`](.github/workflows/build.yml) and deployed only after the real
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` validator accepts it.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| TypeScript | compiles clean |
| Tests | Pass offline against fixtures recorded from the live catalog — `pnpm test` |
| Published index | Format 1, accepted by the real validator, rebuilt daily |
| Automation | daily cron, plus `workflow_dispatch` for a manual rebuild |

The exact plugin count is deliberately not quoted here: the pipeline reads the live
catalog, so it moves by a few entries between runs as upstream gains, loses, and re-pins
repositories. Query the index, or read the run summary in Actions, for today's number.
See [Running locally](#running-locally) to build it yourself.

## Run your own market

This repository is a template. Fork it, point it at a catalog, and it publishes your own
market at your own GitHub Pages URL, rebuilt daily — no server, and nothing hardcoded to
this account. **[Publishing your own plugin market →](FORKING.md)**

## What it produces

`dist/index.json` — a single format-1 document, published at
<https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/index.json>. Additional **profiles** declared
in `config/config.yml` each produce their own document (for example a star-floor subset
published as its own market), and each is validated independently in CI.

### What the market declares

Format 1 lets a market publish its own curated vocabulary, and Discover renders all of
it. This market uses each axis:

| Axis | What is declared | What it gives you in Discover |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `metadata.categories` | Upstream's 23 categories, translated | The category pills above the list |
| `metadata.labels` | Permission capabilities, risk findings, popularity buckets | The **Labels** filter menu and the tags on each card |
| `metadata.sortKeys` | `stars`, `downloads`, `added` | **Sort** menu entries, each opening descending |
| `metadata.keywords` | Runtime identity, category, and capability words | Free-text search recall |

**Labels** are the most useful of the four, because they answer questions the upstream
catalog cannot. They come from three places:

- **Capabilities** — upstream's trust scan reports what each plugin's code can reach:
  `fs-read`, `fs-write`, `network`, `shell`, `env`, `credentials`, `llm`,
  `host-runtime`, `dynamic-code`, `subagent`. Filtering for `shell` finds every plugin
  that can run commands on your machine.
- **Risk findings**, normalised into five classes rather than the 86 raw sentences
  upstream publishes (most name a single domain or IP): `risk:credentials-and-network`
  (476 entries), `risk:plaintext-http` (97), `risk:literal-ip` (47),
  `risk:install-time-code` (22), and `risk:dynamic-code`.
- **Popularity buckets** — `stars:1k+` / `100+` / `10+` / `1+` / `0` and
  `downloads:10k+` / `1k+` / `100+` / `1+` / `0`.

Popularity is bucketed rather than exact, and that is a format constraint: a label id is
declared once and *referenced* by plugins, so there is no per-plugin label value. Exact
values would need 235 labels for stars and 1,690 for downloads, which turns the filter
menu into an unusable list. The exact numbers are still there where they matter — they
are the `stars` and `downloads` sort keys, and DSH hands them to the model through its
`plugin_market` tool.

### Sources

| What | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Upstream catalog (the data) | <https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json> · [awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) |
| Version history (npm) | <https://registry.npmjs.org/> — one document per npm package |
| This converter (the code) | <https://github.com/hytime/dsh-discover-index> |
| Published index (what DSH reads) | <https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/index.json> |

The index is a **conversion** of the upstream list, not an independent registry. Upstream
curates and hosts the catalog; this repository only converts it to format 1, checks it
against the real validator, and republishes it on a daily schedule. A bad entry should be
reported upstream; a bad *conversion* of a good entry belongs here.

### Version history

Upstream names exactly one version per entry. DSH's plugin page lists every version it can
install and refuses those the running DSH does not satisfy through `engines.dsh` — neither
of which means anything with a single version per plugin. The build therefore reads each
npm package's registry document and lists every version that declares `dsh.bundle`, is not
deprecated, and has a publish time (2,607 documents, roughly 150 MB on a cold run).

Git-resolved plugins still list the one version their pinned commit declares. A registry
that cannot be reached is not fatal: the plugin keeps its upstream version, because losing
a plugin to a registry outage would be worse than showing one version of it.

### Provenance in the document

The published document carries that provenance in its own `description`, so the source
travels with the data and is visible in Discover without consulting this README:

```json
"description": {
  "en": "The awesome-dsh-plugin list converted to the plugin market index format 1. Source: https://github.com/hytime/dsh-discover-index",
  "zh": "由 awesome-dsh-plugin 列表转换而来的插件市场索引（格式 1）。源码：https://github.com/hytime/dsh-discover-index"
}
```

## How upstream data maps to format 1

Upstream `plugins.json` is a curated list with its own schema; format 1 has a stricter
one. The aggregator converts entry by entry, and the two install paths differ:

| Upstream entry | Format-1 result |
| --- | --- |
| Names an npm package (`npm` + `version`) | One version with `source: { "type": "npm" }`. The package name is authoritative — it is what the registry actually serves — and installation needs no build step on the user's machine. The name is taken from the package, never inferred from the repository name. |
| Git-only (no npm package) | The repository is resolved, its manifest read, and one version emitted with `source: { "type": "git", "url": …, "commit": "<40-hex SHA>" }`. The commit is **pinned**, never a branch or tag, so an index entry always resolves to immutable code. |
| Monorepo subdirectory | The repository and the package directory are split into `repository.directory` (display) and `source.path` (install). |
| Cannot be resolved to a real package name and version | **Dropped.** Format 1 requires a non-empty `versions` array, so an unresolvable entry is never emitted as an empty shell. `node dist/cli.js doctor` reports every drop and why. |

Other mapping rules:

- **Display metadata** — titles, descriptions, icons, author, and repository come from
  upstr

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：分层任务记忆 + 关系图谱 + 索引常驻稳定前缀；零运行时依赖，另附同源的 Agent skill 形态
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lmmarr

DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆插件。**lmmArr** = *long-memory, as a task graph*。

一句话定位：让「我在做什么、做到哪、和什么有关」**零成本常驻**，并且**按任务只读那一块记忆**。

## 它解决什么

上下文压缩会丢细节，RAG 只能"再找回来"，而每开一个新会话，模型都得重新被告知你是谁、在做什么。
本插件的做法不是压缩，而是**换一种组织方式**：

| 层 | 文件 | 谁在维护 | 成本 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 原始 | `YYYY-MM-DD.md` | 人手工写，append-only | 零（不进上下文） |
| 任务 | `MEMORY_<任务ID>.md` | 模型按需读写 | 只在召回该任务时进上下文 |
| 索引 | `MEMORY.md` | 工具自动重写 | **常驻**（投影进系统提示，确定性、有预算） |

关键在最后一行：索引被**逐字**放进了稳定前缀，所以它是"免费"的 —— 引擎的前缀缓存第一次算完就留住了。
索引里**不含时间戳**，同一份记忆投影出的文本逐字相同；这是缓能否命中的充要条件，也是本仓 `docs/design.md` 里那条论证的落地。

## 安装

从源码直接挂载（免构建，当前可用）：

```bash
dsh web --patch ./cordis.yml
```

从 npm 安装（包尚未发布，发布后可用）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lmmarr
```

自检（改配置后务必看一眼，dsh 对配置错误是**静默忽略**而不是报错）：

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A8 "id: lmmarr"
```

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `dir` | `<cwd>/.dsh-memory` | 记忆目录 |
| `depth` | `1` | `lmmarr_context` 的默认邻域跳数 |
| `writeEnabled` | `true` | 设 `false` 整插件只读；写工具会**明确拒绝并说明原因**，而不是静默无效 |
| `guidance` | `true` | 是否注入记忆协议到系统提示 |
| `hotMemory` | `true` | 是否把索引投影进上下文 |
| `maxProjectionCharacters` | `2000` | 投影的字符预算；超出先丢关系、再裁任务，且**显式说明截断** |
| `bodySoftLimit` | `16000` | 单个任务正文的软上限；超出只在索引里提示「该拆了」，不自动改写 |
| `timeoutMs` | `10000` | 工具执行超时 |

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lmmarr_index` | 读完整索引（任务表 + 关系图 + 一致性问题）。索引已在上下文里，**只在需要全表或要报告问题时调用** |
| `lmmarr_context` | 读一个任务 + 其直接邻域，**其余文件一个不碰**。这是读记忆的正道 |
| `lmmarr_upsert` | 建/改一个任务记忆文件。同 id 复用即更新，**未传的字段一律保留** |
| `lmmarr_link` | 声明 `child`（拆解）/ `depends`（前置）/ `relates`（弱关联）；`child`/`depends` 必须无环，成环的边会被拒绝且**什么都不改** |
| `lmmarr_forget` | 删一个任务文件并带走它的关系。破坏性操作，只在用户明确要求或条目确实错了时用 |

## 架构

```
src/
  index.ts       插件入口：只做「按 dsh 规范挂载」这一件事
  guidance.ts    记忆协议 → systemPrompt.section（告诉模型何时该用、何时绝不该写）
  project.ts     热记忆投影 → systemPrompt.section（确定性、有预算、无时间戳）
  service.ts     Cordis 服务 lmmarrMemory（工具只是它的一层视图）
  memory/        记忆内核：graph（图谱）/ store（存储）/ nodefs / cli
  index/         未接入的检索路线探索（embedding / 一致性哈希 / 任务归纳），论证见 docs/design.md
```

三条设计约束，都写进了测试：

1. **内核对外零依赖**。`graph.ts` / `store.ts` 只认一个 `FsPort` 接口，所以能完全离线单测。
2. **写路径唯一**。「采集问题 → 重写索引 → 返回快照」收敛在 `service.refresh()` 一处。顺序不可换：重写索引会把悬空边自愈掉，先写再查就永远报不出问题。
3. **引导与工具分离**。工具的 `description` 只说"能做什么"；"什么时候用、什么时候绝不该写回"必须常驻系统提示，模型才会形成纪律。

## 开发

```bash
npm run verify      # 类型检查 + 全部测试 + 构建
npm test            # 只跑测试（node --test，无需构建）
npm run build       # tsc → lib/
npm pack            # prepack 会自动构建；产物只含 lib/ + cordis.patch.yml + 文档
npm run verify:name # 发布前包名闸门
npm run verify:mount # 挂载探针：真实 boot 一次，确认 5 个工具与两段引导真进了模型可见面（不花模型调用）
```

发布流程与坑清单见仓库内的 `docs/publishing.md`（维护者文档，不随 npm 包发布）。

## 同一套记忆，装成 Agent skill

`skill/` 是同一份记忆内核的 skill 形态（`SKILL.md` + `references/` + 零依赖脚本），供按 skill 机制加载的宿主使用。它与 dsh 插件**同源**——都编译自 `src/memory/`，不会分裂成两份实现：

```bash
npm run sync:skill   # src/memory → skill/scripts，并安装到 ~/.workbuddy/skills/lmmarr-memory
```

`skill/tools/agents-probe.mjs` 是一个零依赖的**能力门**：探测当前框架有没有子代理，输出 `MODE delegate|self-compress`，给「探索性工作该委派出去、还是只留结论」这条纪律分叉用。

## 与 dsh-mnemon 的关系

本插件的架构骨架（引导层、视图/注意力分离、服务化、打包与发布形态）参考了 [`dsh-mnemon`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon)。
刻意的取舍：

**借鉴**：系统提示里常驻的记忆协议；把能力 `provide` 成服务、工具只做视图；`params` 走 JSON Schema 子集（每个 `object` 必须显式 `additionalProperties`）；发布形态（`lib/` 构建产物 + `dsh.bundle.patch` + `exports`/`files` 白名单）。

**不跟**：多 provider 后端（9 个外部记忆服务）、React 客户端 UI、Git 同步与 GitHub 登录、子代理协调器、`view_route`/`view_action` 的双层间接寻址。这些在 mnemon 的规模下是必要的，在我们这里主要变成维护面。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中一键开关 REA MCP 服务器（rea-mcp），并向模型暴露配套的开关工具 rea_mcp_toggle；选择按 profile 持久化，重启后依然生效。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-rea-mcp-toggle

一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）bundle 插件：**在 Harness Web UI 里一键开关 REA MCP 服务器**，并把同一个开关交给模型（工具 `rea_mcp_toggle`）。选择按 profile 保存，重启后依然生效。

> 适用：DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`（web profile）。零运行时依赖（只用 Node 内置模块 + dsh 宿主服务）。

---

## 1. 项目解决什么问题

REA（[Reverse Engineer Anything](https://github.com/morluto/rea)）通过 MCP 以 stdio 方式接入 DSH。它的工具集非常大：**开启时是 170 个 `mcp__rea__*` 工具**，这些工具的 schema 会随**每一次**请求一起发给模型。

实测同一实例、同一时刻，`Tool.listTools` 的返回体大小：

| REA 状态 | 工具数 | tools payload |
|---|---|---|
| 开启 | 251 | **722,353 字节** |
| 关闭 | 81 | **94,807 字节** |

差价 **627 KB** 全部是那 170 个工具的定义。它们**每次都进请求**，于是产生两种浪费：

1. **token 费用**：不管这一轮到底用不用逆向工具，都在为这 627 KB 付费（长会话里反复累积）；
2. **进程与内存**：REA 的 MCP 子进程常驻（单进程约 240 MB），只有关掉才会退出。

而 DSH 自带的「插件开关」（Plugin Manager 里把 `rea-mcp` 行禁用）**对这一行无效**——原因见第 6 节，这不是配置问题，是 patch 层的机制决定的。所以本项目提供了能真正生效、且能持久化的开关。

**典型场景**：平时关着，等真要分析二进制 / APK 时再打开；或者反过来，只在需要省 token 时临时关闭。

---

## 2. 主要功能

### 2.1 UI 开关（主入口）

会话标题栏（Session header）里的一个小按钮，与「费用明细」等控件并列：

- 显示 **`REA 开`** / **`REA 关`**，绿点表示当前状态；
- 点一下切换：**即时生效，不需要重启 Harness**；
- 切换失败时按钮直接变成 **`REA 失败`**（红框），鼠标悬停显示具体原因 —— 不会静默无效；
- 鼠标悬停还会显示当前工具数与配置行 id。

### 2.2 模型工具 `rea_mcp_toggle`

| action | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `status` | 读当前开关状态、工具数、是否已持久化、状态文件路径 |
| `set` | 切换（需 `enabled: true/false`）；**幂等**，重复同向不发写、不产生副作用 |
| `probe` | 诊断：Loader 行状态、REA 工具数、缝是否在位、服务可用性、Remote endpoint 解析情况 |
| `selftest` | 用 **Web UI 调用的同一条 Remote 网关路径**自检本插件（用来区分「UI 坏了」还是「Host 坏了」） |

UI 按钮与这个工具**共用同一套实现**（同一 service 的同一个方法），不存在两份逻辑。

### 2.3 状态持久化

选择保存在插件自己的状态文件里：

```
%DSH_PROFILE_DIR%\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json     例如 {"enabled": false, "savedAt": "..."}
```

写入是原子的（临时文件 + rename）。重启后由家目录层的一行 `!!js` 缝读取该文件，**开机即按选择生效**（关闭状态下开机根本不会拉起 REA）。

### 2.4 工具可见性真正变化

关闭时 170 个 `mcp__rea__*` 工具从**模型可调用工具列表**中消失（不只是「不执行」）；开启时全部回来。

### 2.5 进程生命周期

- 开启：拉起 REA 的 stdio 子进程（**每次切换恰好 1 个**）；
- 关闭：dispose 该行，回收子进程、注销工具；
- 关闭后**不会自己复活**（曾有一个「关闭后子进程又起来」的缺陷，已修并可复现验证）。

---

## 3. 安装方法

### 3.1 前置条件

- 已安装 DSH，且 REA 已作为 MCP server 注册在**家目录层** `%DSH_HOME%\cordis.patch.yml`，形如：

  ```yaml
  - insert:
      - id: rea-mcp
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
        config:
          serverName: rea
          transport: stdio
          command: '<HARNESS_ROOT>\node\bin\node.exe'
          args: ['<NPM_GLOBAL>\node_modules\rea-agents\scripts\rea.mjs', 'mcp']
          env: { REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE: compact }
          toolCallTimeoutMs: 900000
          failOnStartupError: false        # 硬约束：REA 坏了也不能让 harness 起不来
  ```

- 该行 id 必须是 **`rea-mcp`**（本插件按这个 id 定位；其它 id 会被明确拒绝，不会误伤）。

### 3.2 安装本 bundle

本插件以**路径链接**方式安装，因此包目录内需要有指向 DSH 安装的 `node_modules` 链接（Node 从包的**真实目录**解析 bare import；本插件运行时只 import `node:fs`，但编译/探针脚本需要）：

```powershell
cd plugins\dsh-rea-mcp-toggle
node scripts/link-deps.mjs
# 通常不需要参数：脚本会自己找 harness（见下），失败时才需要显式给根目录
# node scripts/link-deps.mjs "<HARNESS_ROOT>"
```

**脚本如何找到 harness**（按顺序，每个候选都会被 marker 校验，**错的目录不会静默胜出**）：

| 顺序 | 来源 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 命令行参数 | `node scripts/link-deps.mjs "<root>"` |
| 2 | `<repo>/.harness-root` | 一行写根目录；模板见 `.harness-root.example`；已被 git 忽略。标准位置都描述不了的布局用这个 |
| 3 | `DSH_HARNESS_ROOT` | 环境变量 |
| 4 | 平台标准安装位置 | Windows：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs`、`%ProgramFiles%`、`%ProgramFiles(x86)%`、`%LOCALAPPDATA%` 下的 `dsh-desktop` / `DeepSeek Harness` / `deepseek-harness`，并在其 `resources/harness` 与 `harness` 处探测；macOS：`/Applications`、`~/Applications`；Linux：`/opt`、`/usr/local/lib`、`/usr/lib` |
| 5 | 正在运行的 Harness | 由进程的 `node.exe` 路径反推安装根，因此装在非标准目录也能找到 |

判定「是 harness 根」的条件：同时存在 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/{cordis,dsh,dsh-tools}` 与 `node_modules/js-yaml`。本仓库自身**被显式排除**（它的 `node_modules` 是链接，否则会自我链接）。

然后在会话里让模型执行（需要 danger-full-access 或当次审批）：

```
plugin_manager → install_bundle → <本目录绝对路径>
```

**安装后必须重启一次 dsh-desktop。** Host 半边的模块是进程启动时导入的；不重启时插件行会处于 `failed to import` 或停在旧版本。

### 3.3 安装家目录层的「开关缝」（必须，一次）

这是**唯一**需要手改家目录层的地方。在你已有的 `rea-mcp` 行里加一个行级 `disabled`（不要放进 `config` 里面）：

```yaml
      - id: rea-mcp
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
        config:
          # ...原有内容保持不动...
        # ── 开关缝：由 dsh-rea-mcp-toggle 插件读取 ──
        disabled: !!js >-
          Boolean(ctx.get('profileContext')?.dir) && (() => { try { return process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs').readFileSync(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(ctx.get('profileContext').dir, '.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json'), 'utf8') && JSON.parse(process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs').readFileSync(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(ctx.get('profileContext').dir, '.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json'), 'utf8')).enabled === false } catch { return false } })()
```

**改前先备份**：`Copy-Item .dsh\cordis.patch.yml .dsh\cordis.patch.yml.bak-<时间戳>`

这段表达式是**安全降级**的：状态文件不存在 / JSON 损坏 / `profileContext` 不可用（例如离线 `dsh --dump-config`）时一律返回 `false`＝保持启用，**不会让 harness 起不来**。

### 3.4 安装后自检

```powershell
node scripts/acceptance.mjs        # 校验缝与状态文件在同一口径上
```

再在会话里执行 `rea_mcp_toggle {action:"selftest"}` —— 它走的就是 Web UI 的 Remote 网关路径。

---

## 4. 使用方法

### 4.1 日常：点按钮

标题栏的 **`REA 开` / `REA 关`** 按钮，点一下即可。不需要重启。

### 4.2 让模型帮你切

```
把 REA 关掉，我在省钱          → 模型调用 rea_mcp_toggle {action:"set", enabled:false}
REA 现在开着吗？               → 模型调用 rea_mcp_toggle {action:"status"}
UI 按钮点了没反应，帮我看看     → 模型调用 rea_mcp_toggle {action:"selftest"}
```

### 4.3 关闭 / 禁用的几种情况

- **临时关**：点按钮。状态文件写 `enabled:false`，当前进程立即生效（工具消失、子进程回收）。
- **永久不再启用**：把手改的那段 `disabled: !!js` 缝从家目录层删掉（保留其余内容），该行即恢复为无条件启用。
- **彻底卸载**：见第 8 节。

---

## 5. 输入输出示例

以下均为**真实运行结果**（本机实测，`compact` schema profile）。

### 5.1 查询状态

输入：

```json
{ "action": "status" }
```

输出（REA 关闭时）：

```text
REA MCP (rea-mcp) is OFF: the mcp__rea__* tools are not callable; the choice is saved.
entry=rea-mcp module=@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
enabled=false persisted=false tools=0 seam=true
stateFile=<PROFILE_DIR>\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json
```

输出（REA 开启时）：

```text
REA MCP (rea-mcp) is ON: 170 tool(s); the choice is saved.
entry=rea-mcp module=@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
enabled=true persisted=true tools=170 seam=false
stateFile=<PROFILE_DIR>\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json
```

> `seam=false` 是正常的：即时开启会清掉该行**进程内**的 `disabled` 键（`probe` 里显示 `rawDisabled=null`），开机时缝会重新求值（那时是 `seam=true`）。

### 5.2 关闭 REA

输入：

```json
{ "action": "set", "enabled": false }
```

输出：

```text
REA MCP (rea-mcp) is OFF: the mcp__rea__* tools are not callable; the choice is saved.
entry=rea-mcp module=@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
enabled=false persisted=false tools=0 seam=false
```

同时 `%DSH_PROFILE_DIR%\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json` 变为：

```json
{ "enabled": false, "savedAt": "2026-10-13T17:59:27.803Z" }
```

### 5.3 开启 REA

输入：

```json
{ "action": "set", "enabled": true }
```

输出（子进程握手完成后）：

```text
REA MCP (rea-mcp) is ON: 170 tool(s); the choice is saved.
enabled=true persisted=true tools=170 seam=false
```

### 5.4 幂等：重复同向不发写

连续两次 `{ "action": "set", "enabled": false }`，第二次不会重写状态文件
（实测文件 `LastWriteTime` 与内容完全不变），也不会新增 patch 行。

### 5.5 诊断

输入：

```json
{ "action": "probe" }
```

输出（节选）：

```text
seam=false reaTools=0 stateFile=...\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json
stateFileExists=true stateFileValue=false services={"loader":true,"tools":true,"typert":true,"pluginManager":true,"typertGateway":true}
row id=rea-mcp-toggle composite=include:rea-mcp-toggle module=dsh-rea-mcp-toggle rawDisabled=false effectiveDisabled=false fiberState=2 parentTree=include
row id=rea-mcp composite=include:rea-mcp module=@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client rawDisabled=true effectiveDisabled=true fiberState=4 parentTree=include
```

读数要点：`effectiveDisabled=true` 且 `fiberState=4`（disposed）＝该行确实已停；
`reaTools=0` ＝ 模型侧看不到 REA 工具。

### 5.6 UI 自检（判断是 UI 坏还是 Host 坏）

输入：

```json
{ "action": "selftest" }
```

输出：

```text
gateway reaMcp/getState ok -> {...}
gateway reaMcp/setEnabled ok -> {...}
restoredTo=false
```

`selftest` 会先记住你的选择，结束后**原样恢复**（诊断不改变开关）。

### 5.7 安装后的效果对照

| 观察点 | 关闭 | 开启 |
|---|---|---|
| `Tool.listTools` 里 `mcp__rea__*` | 0 个 | 170 个 |
| `listTools` payload | ≈ 94.8 KB | ≈ 722.4 KB |
| 该实例的 REA 子进程 | 0 个 | 1 个 |
| 开销最大的部分 | — | 170 个工具 schema 进每次请求 |

---

## 6. 为什么不能用 profile 层的 `disabled`（关键设计决定）

DSH 的 patch 分层是：**bundle 层 → profile 层（`%DSH_PROFILE_DIR%\cordis.patch.yml`）→ 家目录层（`%DSH_HOME%\cordis.patch.yml`）→ `--patch` 覆盖**，后者覆盖前者。

`rea-mcp` 行是**家目录层**用

plugins.description: Hedged requests for streaming /v1/messages LLM calls: fires a second attempt when response headers miss a deadline and races them, retries immediately on 5xx/504, passes through 4xx/429, with statistics.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ttft-hedge

TTFT 优化：对发往 LLM 中继 /v1/messages 的流式请求做对冲（hedged request）——deadline 内未收到响应头则并行发第二个请求，先到先用；5xx/504 立即重抽；4xx/429 原样返回。附统计工具与 stats 文件。

由 dsh-super-injector dev_scaffold_plugin 生成。

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh
# 注入器环境内：dev_inject_plugin <本目录>
```

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. # dsh-changelog-zh

从真实 git 历史生成**两份中文变更日志**：

- **用户版（短）**——一段可以直接贴进群公告或 Release 正文的中文说明；
- **开发者版（长）**——每条提交带完整 SHA、分类依据、文件增减、验证证据原文。

两份里的**每一条都带 commit SHA 和「已验证／未验证」标记**。

这个工具的三个承诺，也是它唯一值得存在的理由：

1. **只说历史里有的事。** 分类靠约定式提交前缀和一张小关键词表，识别不出就写「未分类」，绝不猜。
2. **「已验证」必须有可引用的证据。** 四类证据之外，一律标「未验证」，并写清缺的是哪一类。只有一句 `verified: true` 而没有证据的，同样算未验证。
3. **不翻译提交信息。** 你没写中文标题的提交，就原样保留英文主题，并明确告诉你「有 N 条没有中文标题」——不会给你一段看起来很像中文、实际是模型编的文案。

当前版本 **0.1.0**。

---

## 它长什么样

下面是这个工具在本文档末尾描述的演示仓库上的**真实输出**（原文粘贴，未手工润色）：

```console
$ node bin/changelog-zh.mjs --repo tmp/demo-repo \
    --sessions tmp/demo-sessions.jsonl --title v1.1.0 \
    --out tmp/demo-out --no-emails --stdout --format user
```

```markdown
# v1.1.0

2026-10-16 · 共 6 条变更：3 条已验证、3 条未验证。

## 破坏性变更

- ⚠ 换掉返回结构（`1993535`，未验证）

## 新功能

- 支持把结果导出成 Markdown（`182d11c`，已验证）

## 修复

- 修掉导出时的编码问题（`46378b4`，已验证）

## 性能

- 导出时少做一次全量拷贝（`83fb0b5`，未验证）

## 重构

- 拆出渲染层（`4939351`，未验证）

## 未分类

- update the deployment notes（`af2971a`，已验证）

> 范围：v1.0.0..HEAD · 共 6 条变更
> 「未验证」只表示提交历史里没有可引用的验证证据，不代表这条改动有问题。
> 判定依据：提交信息或 git notes 里的验证 trailer（`已验证:` / `Verified:` / `测试:` …），或会话记录里退出码为 0 的验证命令。完整规则见开发者版。
> 其中 1 条没有中文标题，原样保留了提交主题（本工具不翻译提交信息）。
> 生成于 2026-10-16T04:06:07.769Z · dsh-changelog-zh@0.1.0 · 数据来源：git log
```

开发者版里同一条「性能」改动是这么写的（节选）——注意它没有把「匹配到会话记录」当成验证通过：

```markdown
### 4. 导出时少做一次全量拷贝（`83fb0b5`，未验证）

- 提交：`83fb0b584d05a391cd8f8deba0e0c5a6c7665bc4`
- 类型：性能（分类依据：提交前缀 perf）
- 破坏性：否
- 作者：林可
- 提交时间：2026-10-10 10:00
- 文件（1 个，+1 −0）：
  - `src/fast.js` +1 −0
- 提交主题（原文）：perf: 导出时少做一次全量拷贝
- 验证：未验证 —— 匹配到 1 条会话记录，但里面没有退出码为 0 的验证命令，也没有 failed=0 且 passed>0 的测试计数
```

以及「提交信息 + git notes 两处都有证据，就把两句原文都抄下来」：

```markdown
- 验证：已验证 —— 提交信息 trailer「测试：node --test，退出码 0」
- 验证：已验证 —— git notes「已验证：node --test 46 passed」
```

---

## 安装与用法

### 作为 DSH 插件（宿主路由 + 会话面板 + 工具）

本插件是零依赖的纯 JS 包，把仓库挂进 DSH 的插件目录即可（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` 已声明）：

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml（本仓库自带）
- insert:
    - id: dsh-changelog-zh
      name: dsh-changelog-zh
```

装上以后有三个入口：

- **会话面板**：对话视图里的「变更日志」标签页，填仓库/范围/会话记录即可生成，可一键复制；
- **HTTP 路由**：`GET /dsh-changelog-zh/state`、`POST /dsh-changelog-zh/generate`、`POST /dsh-changelog-zh/clear`；
- **工具**：`changelog_zh`，参数 `{ repo, range, since, limit, includeMerges, sessions, format }`，`format` 取 `user` / `dev` / `both`。

插件配置（都可选）：

```jsonc
{
  "roots": [],            // 路径白名单；非空时只允许生成这些目录下的仓库
  "defaultRepo": "",      // 请求没给仓库时用哪个
  "defaultRange": "",     // 默认范围，如 "v1.0.0..HEAD"
  "sessionsPath": "",     // 会话记录文件
  "titlesPath": "",       // 中文标题映射文件
  "maxCommits": 300       // 单次最多读多少条提交
}
```

### 作为命令行工具

```console
$ node bin/changelog-zh.mjs --repo D:\Projects\某项目 --title v1.1.0
已写入 D:\Projects\某项目\CHANGELOG-user.md  —— 用户版（短）
已写入 D:\Projects\某项目\CHANGELOG-dev.md  —— 开发者版（长）
范围 v1.0.0..HEAD · 6 条提交 · 已验证 3 · 未验证 3 · 已隐去 0 处 · 会话记录匹配 2 条
```

全部参数：

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <路径>` | 仓库路径，默认当前目录 |
| `--range <范围>` | 如 `v1.0.0..HEAD`、`HEAD~5..HEAD`；不写则自动（见下） |
| `--since <日期>` | 只取该日期之后的提交，如 `2026-10-01`、`"2026-10-01 09:00"` |
| `--limit <条数>` | 最多读多少条提交（默认 300，上限 5000） |
| `--merges` | 把合并提交也算进来（默认不含） |
| `--sessions <文件>` | 叠加会话记录（格式见下） |
| `--titles <文件>` | 中文标题映射 JSON，形如 `{"<完整或短 sha>": "中文标题"}` |
| `--title <标题>` | 覆盖两份文案的标题 |
| `--format user\|dev\|both` | 只产出其中一版（默认 `both`） |
| `--out <目录>` | 输出目录，默认仓库根目录 |
| `--stdout` | 同时打印到标准输出 |
| `--json` | 把完整报告打成 JSON 到标准输出（不写文件） |
| `--no-authors` / `--no-emails` | 开发者版里隐去作者／邮箱 |
| `-h` / `-v` | 用法 / 版本 |

退出码：`0` 成功、`2` 参数错误、`1` 生成失败（错误码写在 stderr，如 `[ENOTREPO]`）。

**自动范围**：没有标签时取最近提交；有标签时取 `最近标签..HEAD`；如果最新标签已经在 HEAD 上（刚打完标签就要写 Release notes 的典型场景），自动回退到**上一个**标签，避免把这次已发布的提交再写一遍。范围是怎么定的，开发者版会写在「范围」那一行里。

---

## 「已验证／未验证」到底怎么判

只有下面四类**可引用证据**存在时，才会标「已验证」：

| # | 证据 | 例子 | 抄进文案的内容 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 提交信息里的验证 trailer | `Verified: node --test → 46 passed` | 原句 |
| 2 | git notes 里的验证 trailer | `git notes add -m "测试：node --test，退出码 0"` | 原句 |
| 3 | 会话记录里退出码为 0 的验证命令 | `{"command":"node --test","exitCode":0}` | 命令 + 退出码 |
| 4 | 会话记录里 `failed=0` 且 `passed>0` 的测试计数 | `{"tests":{"passed":46,"failed":0}}` | 计数 |

trailer 的键名认这些（大小写不敏感、中英都行）：`verified` / `verified-by` / `verify` / `verification` / `tested` / `tested-by` / `test` / `tests` / `evidence` / `check` / `checked` / `已验证` / `验证` / `自测` / `测试` / `测试结果` / `测试通过` / `证据`。写成 `**已验证**：…` 这种加粗形式也认得。

两条**从严**的例外，请特别注意：

- **通过与失败并存 ⇒ 未验证。** 如果同一提交既有一句 `Verified:`，又有一条退出码非 0 的测试记录，本工具按「未验证」处理，并在文案里写明「存在失败的验证证据」。宁可保守。
- **声称 ≠ 证据。** 会话记录里只有 `"verified": true`、却没给命令/退出码/计数的，依旧标「未验证」，理由写成「声称已验证但没有证据」。

反过来，「未验证」**不代表改动有问题**——它只表示提交历史里没留下能引用的证据。这条也会印在每一份用户版文案的页脚里，免得被读者误读。

本工具**不会**从「改了测试文件」「diff 很大」「提交信息写得很详细」这类形状去推断验证结论。

---

## 脱敏

渲染之前先脱敏，命中即替换为 `<已隐去:类型>`，并在文案里报出命中数量：

GitHub token（`ghp_` / `gho_` / `ghs_` / `ghu_` / `ghr_` / `github_pat_`）、`sk-` 类 API key、Slack token、AWS access key id、JWT、`Bearer …`、私钥块（`-----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY-----`）、带密码的连接串、`password: xxx` / `token: xxx` 这类赋值、以及本机用户路径（`C:\Users\…` 与 `C:/Users/…` 两种写法）。仓库根目录与 origin 地址在进入报告前也会过一遍脱敏。

一个真实例子：一条提交信息里写了 `token ghp_***`，用户版和开发者版里都只会出现 `<已隐去:github-token>`，页脚写「已在生成时隐去 1 处疑似凭据或本机用户路径」。

---

## 会话记录格式

这是一个**约定的摘要文件**，不是 DSH 内部会话库的格式。支持 JSON 数组、单个 JSON 对象，或 JSONL（`#` 开头是注释，空行忽略）：

```jsonl
{"commit":"182d11c","title":"支持把结果导出成 Markdown","commands":[{"command":"node --test","exitCode":0},{"command":"npm run lint"}],"tests":{"passed":46,"failed":0}}
{"commit":"af2971a","verification":{"command":"node --test","exitCode":0,"evidence":"46 passed"}}
```

- `commit`：完整 sha、唯一前缀（≥4 位）或短 sha 都能匹配；**有歧义就进「歧义清单」，不猜**；
- 匹配不上的记录进「未匹配清单」，开发者版会列出记录与原因；
- `title` / `titleZh`（也认 `summary`）用作中文标题来源，优先级低于 `--titles` 映射、高于提交 trailer；

匹配上**不等于**已验证：记录里必须有上面第 3、4 类证据。

---

## 它不做什么

- **不联网**，不调用任何模型 API；除 `git` 只读命令外不执行别的进程；**不写任何文件**（CLI 的 `--out` 除外）。
- **不改仓库**：不发提交、不打标签、不写 notes。
- **不翻译、不推断**（见上文三个承诺）。
- **不解析 DSH 内部会话库**：会话记录只认上面这个约定格式。
- 合并提交默认不进日志（要就加 `--merges`）；空提交与合并提交在开发者版里会写「文件：无（可能是空提交或合并提交）」，不会假装它有改动。

---

## 参考了什么、有什么不同

本工程是**独立实现**，没有 fork、没有克隆任何人的仓库、没有拷贝任何第三方代码。

**骨架**照的是本机另一个自己写的 DSH 插件工程 `dsh-warden`（同一作者）：零依赖 `scripts/build.mjs`（`src/*.js` → `lib/`）、`cordis.patch.yml` 描述片段、宿主半区 + 客户端半区 + `test/*.test.mjs` 的布局、`scripts/wrap-client.mjs` 的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 包装方式、`.gitattributes` 的 LF 约定。差异在于职责完全相反：warden 是在工具调用**之前**拦一层，本插件是读 git 历史**之后**产出一段文案；因此本插件没有 `rules.js`/`classify.js` 那套判定流水线，而是 `git → classify → evidence → redact → render` 这条只读链路，并且附带一个可独立运行的 CLI。

**生态定位**（下面两条事实来自 GitHub API 返回的仓库公开描述，我没有读它们的源码，本工程不含它们任何代码）：

- [`7dgroup-ai/dsh-skill-7d-git-commit`](https://github.com/7dgroup-ai/dsh-skill-7d-git-commit)：公开描述是「在生成任何 `git commit` 提交信息前，自动按 7DGroup 项目提交规范进行校验」。它管的是**提交信息的规范**（写之前）。
- [`andyfan1094/dsh-github`](https://github.com/andyfan1094/dsh-github)：公开描述是「GitHub authentication and local Git workflow plugin for the dsh web GUI」，是账号认证与本地 Git 工作流面板。

两者都不产出「从真实变更生成一份敢公开的中文文案」。本插件补的就是这一环。需要说明的是，这个「生态里没人做」的判断来自上面两条公开描述，不是穷尽调研——如果你知道已经有同类插件，欢迎在 issue 里告诉我。

同样地，本工程**故意没有** `screenshots.json`、没有伪造的面板截图：作者没有把插件装进自己的 DSH 配置里跑过面板渲染，所以不给不存在的截图。面板行为由 `test/host.test.mjs` 里的宿主契约测试覆盖（路由前缀、状态码、工具 schema、卸载），而不是靠图片证明。

---

## 开发

```console
$ node scripts/build.mjs          # src/*.js -> lib/（host.js -> index.js），并内联客户端 CSS
$ node --test test/*.test.mjs     # 全部测试
```

- 零运行时依赖，`devDependencies` 为空；只需要 Node ≥ 22 与 `git`。
- `lib/` 是入库的构建产物，`test/build.test.mjs` 会逐字节比对 `lib/` 与 `src/`，改了源码忘了构建会直接红。
- 测试里凡是涉及 git 的都**真的建临时仓库**（`test/helpers/repo.mjs`），不 mock git；本机没有 `git` 时这些用例自动 skip 并说明原因。
- CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）在 Node 22 / 24 上跑构建一致性 + 全部测试 + CLI 冒烟。

plugins.readme_text:
# 抓虾数据插件 · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）CSV / Excel / JSON

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data/releases) · [DSH Plugin topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

抓虾数据工具是面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的独立本地数据插件，可在 DSH 进程内预览、统计、清洗和导出 JSON、CSV、Excel（XLSX）数据。它适合商品表检查、库存汇总、订单数据整理，以及把浏览器或脚本产物转换成新的表格文件。无需安装抓虾应用或后端，也不需要抓虾 API Token、Python 运行时或其他配套插件；这是独立社区项目，不是 DeepSeek 官方插件。

## 快速开始

需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，以及已验证的 DSH **0.2.1-alpha.4**。通过 GitHub Release 安装预打包版本，或直接安装带 JavaScript 产物的 GitHub 标签：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data#v0.2.1
DSH_DATA_WORKSPACE=/absolute/path/to/data dsh --profile ecommerce --dump-config
DSH_DATA_WORKSPACE=/absolute/path/to/data dsh --profile ecommerce
```

无需执行包构建脚本。也可以克隆仓库后执行 `npm ci`，再安装本地目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w /absolute/path/to/dsh-crawshrimp-data
```

`DSH_DATA_WORKSPACE` 指定插件使用的工作目录；未指定时默认使用 DSH 启动目录。也可以在 profile patch 中覆盖完整配置：

```yaml
- id: crawshrimp-data
  config:
    workspaceDir: /absolute/path/to/data
```

详细安装方式见 [官方 bundle 安装文档](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)。项目通过 GitHub 分发，未假定已经发布到 npm 注册表。

## 能力概览

| 工具 | 能力 |
| --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_data_preview` | 读取 JSON、CSV、XLSX，选择工作表，按页返回最多 100 行 |
| `crawshrimp_data_profile` | 统计缺失值、不同值数量，以及数值列的最小值、最大值、合计和均值 |
| `crawshrimp_data_export` | 将 JSON 记录写入新的 CSV 或 XLSX 文件；不会覆盖已有文件 |
| `crawshrimp_data_transform` | 声明式筛选、去重、排序、选列和重命名；可只预览或保存新文件 |

文件读取和写入限定在配置的 `workspaceDir`。写文件使用 DSH 原生审批信号：当会话同时处于 `danger-full-access` 且原生审批策略为 `never` 时，已有完全权限授予，插件不会重复请求逐次审批；其他状态继续走原生审批路径，无法获得审批时故障关闭。插件不会覆盖已有文件，同一插件实例的会话共享该工作目录。

## 使用示例

可以直接对 DSH 说：

> 预览 `products.xlsx`，统计缺失价格和库存，然后把选定记录导出到 `products-clean.csv`。

工具调用可以传入 JSON 记录：

```json
{
  "path": "products-clean.csv",
  "rows": [
    { "sku": "A001", "price": 39.5, "stock": 8 },
    { "sku": "A002", "price": 60.5, "stock": 0 }
  ]
}
```

将该对象交给 `crawshrimp_data_export`，再用 `crawshrimp_data_profile` 读取 `{"path":"products.xlsx"}`。以零开头的货号必须传为 JSON 字符串，例如 `"00123"`。CSV 导出会为可能被表格软件识别为公式的文本（含表头）加前置单引号；XLSX 文本保持字面值。

## 商品表清洗与脚本衔接

JSON 输入可以是记录数组，也可以是脚本产物 `{ "success": true, "data": [...] }`。明确声明 `success: false` 的失败产物会被拒绝。记录必须由扁平标量字段组成；`001` 等标识符作为字符串保持原样。JSON 的 `null` 与空字符串在内部保持区别，CSV/XLSX 写入时 `null` 表示空单元格。空数组可以通过 `{ "columns": [...], "data": [] }` 声明表头。

调用 `crawshrimp_data_transform` 可以使用以下计划：

```json
{
  "path": "products.json",
  "filters": [{ "column": "stock", "op": "gt", "value": 0 }],
  "dedupeBy": ["sku"],
  "sortBy": [{ "column": "price", "numeric": true, "direction": "desc" }],
  "columns": ["sku", "price", "stock"],
  "rename": { "sku": "product_id" }
}
```

不传 `outputPath` 时只计算预览、行数和统计；加上 `"outputPath": "products-clean.xlsx"` 或 `.csv` 路径后，才会通过原生权限检查保存新文件。处理顺序固定为：筛选 → 去重（保留第一条）→ 排序 → 选列/重命名。计划中的列名都指输入列；不执行表达式、SQL 或 JavaScript。即使结果为零行，只要声明了表头，也会生成带表头的文件。`crawshrimp_data_export` 的 `rows` 为空时必须提供 `columns`。

筛选条件按 AND 组合：`eq`、`ne`、`contains`、`in`（传 `values`）、`gt`、`gte`、`lt`、`lte`、`is_empty`、`not_empty`。相等比较保留类型差异；CSV 单元格读出为字符串。数值比较只接受有限十进制数或对应字符串，不解析带货币符号的文本。排序默认按文本比较；要按数值排序请设置 `numeric: true`，空值和无法解析的数值排在最后。最多 20 个筛选条件和 5 个排序键。转换预览最多返回 20 行和 256 KiB，并明确报告是否截断；保存文件包含完整的有界结果。示例见 [`examples/sample-products.json`](examples/sample-products.json) 和 [`examples/transform-products.json`](examples/transform-products.json)。

## 范围与限制

- 输入支持不超过 10 MiB 的 JSON、UTF-8 CSV 和 XLSX；表格最多 10,000 行、200 列、200,000 个单元格，列名最多 256 个字符，表头必须非空且不重复。
- 导出输入最多 5 MiB JSON，单元格最多 10,000 个字符；普通预览最多返回 100 行且结果不得超过 512 KiB。
- XLSX 公式单元格只使用已保存的缓存值，没有缓存值时返回标记；公式和宏不会执行。日期不会在 CSV 与 XLSX 之间自动统一。
- XLSX 解析前会限制 ZIP 条目数量和展开大小。超出边界时会明确报错，不会静默截断大型数据。
- 目录约束是常规本地路径和软链接检查，不能替代防御其他进程并发修改软链接的操作系统沙箱。
- 插件不编辑已有复杂工作簿，不重算公式、不渲染图表，也不连接卖家账号或商家系统。

仓库的 `npm test` 覆盖真实中文 CSV/XLSX 往返、数值统计、公式文本、路径与软链接越界、拒绝覆盖、取消、实际 Cordis/DSH ToolRuntime 中的注册/审批/卸载，以及完全权限、`ask`、受限策略和审批服务缺失/异常时的权限映射。插件不调用模型 API，也不需要真实商家账号。

## 相关插件

[浏览器插件](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) · [Office 插件](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office)。浏览器、数据和 Office 插件分别安装、可以独立运行；网页脚本和翻页能力归浏览器插件。

MIT。能力设计来自抓虾的本地产物处理流程，运行实现直接使用独立 Node 库。

## 版本说明

0.2.1 对齐 DSH 原生完全权限策略：`danger-full-access` 与 `never` 同时成立时不重复请求审批；其他状态继续走原生审批并在无法获批时故障关闭。0.2.0 新增 JSON 产物直读和声明式表格转换；0.1.0 标签已被替代。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: Independent workspace last-used ordering for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar (experimental)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-sorter

Independent **workspace-folder ordering** for DeepSeek Harness, with its own
**Workspace order** section in the existing sidebar View options menu.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workspace-sorter.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workspace-sorter)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![CI](https://github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-workspace-sorter/actions/workflows/check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-workspace-sorter/actions/workflows/check.yml)

- **Source code:** [github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-workspace-sorter](https://github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-workspace-sorter)
- **npm package:** [npmjs.com/package/dsh-workspace-sorter](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workspace-sorter)

**Contents:** [Why this plugin exists](#why-this-plugin-exists) ·
[Install](#install-from-npm) · [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-limitations) ·
[Development](#build-and-test) · [Local setup](./LOCAL-SETUP.md) · [Release checklist](./RELEASE.md)

## Why this plugin exists

DSH's native **Order by → Last updated** orders sessions inside each workspace,
not the workspace folders themselves. This plugin adds an independent ordering
choice without overwriting the host's saved manual workspace order.

## Install from npm

This checkout prepares **0.1.3**, including the running-workspace folder glow and collapsed-workspace name quick-open. Version 0.1.3 has not been published by this change. Avoid 0.1.0, which failed the isolated GUI boot test.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-workspace-sorter
```

Disable the older `dsh-workspace-sort` plugin if installed, finish active work,
restart DSH when required, and refresh the actual DSH Web page. Then open
**Workspaces → View options → Workspace order**.

To remove:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workspace-sorter
```

Restart when required and refresh. No host order needs restoring. Only the
browser preference remains.

## Workspace name quick-open

When a workspace is **collapsed**, clicking its **name** expands it and opens
its latest non-archived session by session update time. Provisional blank
sessions are skipped; an empty workspace simply expands. Clicking the arrow,
folder glyph, or empty row area keeps native expand/collapse-only behavior.
Workspace action buttons are untouched. Clicking the name of an already
expanded workspace keeps native collapse behavior. Modified clicks do not
trigger auto-navigation. This does not change the saved session ordering.

## Running workspace indicator

Workspace folder icons glow **green** while any member session is running,
even when the workspace is collapsed. A selected-but-idle session does not
trigger the glow. Running child agents listed in a member session's subagent
catalog also count. The indicator follows DSH's live session-status store and
clears when the work stops. It works with either workspace-order choice.

The glow is steady (no flashing animation). Only the folder glyph receives
color and shadow; native row selection, labels, and session indicators remain
unchanged. It does not imply a workspace has merely been selected. The
implementation and status aggregation are unit-tested; the full running →
idle transition still needs a real-agent browser test. The sidebar smoke suite
passes with the indicator wrapper installed.

## The Workspace order menu

| Option | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Manual workspace order** (default) | Displays the host's saved manual order. |
| **Last used workspace** | Latest member-session activity first; empty workspaces last and ties in manual order. |

The native session-order choice remains independent. See the limitations below.

> **0.1.3 candidate — not published by this change.** Published 0.1.0 failed real-browser activation in a clean DSH profile; avoid enabling it. The corrected candidate passes 10/10 real-browser smoke checks and 4/4 post-uninstall checks on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. Broader coexistence and interaction testing remains pending. See [RELEASE.md](./RELEASE.md).

Independent workspace ordering in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's existing **View options** popup, below its session-order options.

- **Workspace order → Manual workspace order** retains the host's saved order (default).
- **Workspace order → Last used workspace** displays workspaces newest first, by the latest `updatedAt` among their member sessions. Empty workspaces sort last; ties retain manual order.
- Session ordering, grouping, archive filtering, pinning, search, rename and delete remain native.
- Preference is browser-local, persisted as `dsh-workspace-sorter.order.v1`. It synchronizes across tabs on the same origin.
- No network requests, credentials, session contents, or persistent host workspace changes.

## Compatibility and limitations

**Pinned internal adapter for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.** The native view-options menu has no public extension slot. This plugin wraps the registered `WorkspaceBrowser` function, transforms the returned `ViewOptionsMenu`, and projects a sorted workspace snapshot. It preserves the original entry's injected services, child-slot permissions, locale, and store. It does not edit installed DSH bundles or manipulate the DOM. This is an internal integration, not a stable public menu API; the adapter waits for native registration and leaves unmatched sidebar components untouched rather than failing application boot.

“Last used” is **latest session activity**, not merely clicking a folder. Activity includes archived sessions. Workspace-tree mode keeps the native hierarchy and applies ordering within it. In flat mode there is no workspace list to reorder. Workspace drag commits are suppressed while Last used is active; switch to Manual before dragging. Session drag behavior remains native. The native drag affordance is still shown.

The UI additions are intentionally English-only. Full browser runtime/HMR and coexistence testing is still required before release. A full refresh after enabling/disabling is required because the adapter changes the live component entry; automatic HMR is not claimed.

## Build and test

```sh
npm run check
npm pack
```

An optional installed-bundle shape check runs when `DSH_TEST_WORKSPACE_CLIENT` points to the installed `dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js` artifact. Without it, that one integration check is skipped so contributors and CI do not need a private DSH installation. This check inspects shape, not browser behavior.

Editable client source is `client/index.mjs`. `scripts/build.mjs` produces `lib/client.js`, using the GUI's React singleton rather than bundling React. Host `index.mjs` is intentionally a no-op; `cordis.patch.yml` registers the dual-face package. No Remote or additional service namespace is required. The sole injected package is `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`, which owns the sidebar and supplies its dependencies.

## Try locally

First test the packed tarball in a disposable web profile. Do not publish without explicit authorization.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-workspace-sorter-0.1.0.tgz
```

Before activating in your normal profile, **disable the existing `dsh-workspace-sort` plugin** (entry `workspace-sort`): it independently overwrites the host's manual order daily and would undermine the meaning of Manual here. This package does not silently disable another plugin. Restart DSH if requested and refresh the actual DSH GUI. Open Workspaces → View options → Workspace order.

Verify manual/last-used toggling, new session activity, reload persistence, narrow/collapsed sidebar, workspace-tree/flat grouping, archive filters, search, session drag, workspace drag in Manual, and uninstall + refresh. Uninstalling leaves only the browser preference; no host order needs restoring.

plugins.description: DSH plugin: report what a GitNexus index left out — skipped large files, index coverage, and git activity crossed with the index.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gitnexus-plus

A DeepSeek Harness plugin for **GitNexus index visibility** — starting with the part
GitNexus itself cannot tell you: **what the index left out**.

## The problem it solves

`gitnexus analyze` silently drops files. Its entire surface for saying so is one
line on stderr, printed once:

```
  Skipped 3 large files (>512KB, likely generated/vendored)
    - dist/app.min.js
    ...and 2 more (set GITNEXUS_VERBOSE=1 to list them all)
```

That line is not returned, not persisted, not queryable, and gone when the terminal
scrolls. Meanwhile the files it names can be the difference between an index that
represents your codebase and one that does not — measured on this machine,
`material-ui` skips 4.4 MB (12.4 % of scanned bytes), and those files contribute
**zero** symbols to the graph.

This plugin turns that line into data, a tool, and a route.

## What it reports

- **Skipped large files** — path, size, share of its language, and two independent
  signals for *why* it is not source: a single-line (minified) heuristic, and a
  build-output path heuristic. Binary assets are detected separately and never
  called minified.
- **Index freshness** — the indexed commit against HEAD, classified `current` /
  `behind` / `diverged` / `unknown` the same way `gitnexus status` does, plus the
  uncommitted-change count.
- **Graph composition** — nodes, edges, communities, processes, embeddings, and
  edges-per-node, all read from the manifest.
- **Query surfaces** — which of graph / keyword search / semantic search are
  actually available, with the reason when one is not. An index with no FTS cannot
  answer keyword queries, and hiding that is how a reader concludes otherwise.
- **Git activity, crossed with the index** — recent commits, authors (bots marked),
  branches, most-changed files and most-recent files, each carrying a three-way
  verdict: *indexed*, *excluded by design*, or **missing from the index**. That last
  one is the point: of the files people are actively editing, which does the graph
  not see?
- **Language distribution by bytes**, split three ways: languages GitNexus can
  *parse* into the graph, formats it merely *recognizes*, and everything else.
- **Resolver confidence** — untyped receiver sites, which make `impact` and
  `context` a lower bound rather than an exact answer.

## Why the git three-way split matters

A two-way "indexed / not indexed" count is misleading. Measured on a real
repository, 1 635 files had been touched in 90 days: 491 indexed, 1 143 absent, and
reporting that as "70 % missing" is wrong — 1 143 of them are lockfiles, dotfiles
and binary assets that no scan would select either. Exactly **one** was a genuine
gap (`src/stores/windowModeStore.ts`). The panel reports the three numbers
separately, and only the third raises a warning.


## Design commitments

**Reuse, don't reimplement.** "Which files did GitNexus skip?" has exactly one
correct answer: the set `walkRepositoryPaths` produced. This plugin deep-imports
GitNexus's own `createIgnoreFilter`, `glob` call and `getLanguageFromFilename`
rather than approximating them, and `test/run.mjs` cross-checks its scan against
`walkRepositoryPaths` on real repositories. If upstream reshapes those modules the
plugin degrades to a documented fallback scan (`ScanReport.primitives === 'fallback'`)
instead of reporting a wrong number.

**Absent is reported as absent.** The size cap an index was built under is read from
that index. Legacy indexes (`meta.json`, no `indexCoverage`) are reported with the
cap *unknown* and a note — never defaulted to today's value, which would misattribute
covered files as skipped.

**Read-only.** Nothing here triggers `analyze`, writes to `.gitnexus/`, or takes the
index lock. A status check must never start a 30-second rebuild.

## Usage

```sh
# CLI, no install
npm run build                       # tsc (host) + tsc (client) + wrap
node lib/bin/gitnexus-coverage.js <repo-path>
node lib/bin/gitnexus-coverage.js -r material-ui     # by registry alias
node lib/bin/gitnexus-coverage.js --all --json       # every indexed repository
node lib/bin/gitnexus-coverage.js <repo> --fail-on-large   # exit 2 — CI gate

# type check
npm run check

# tests
npm test
```

In DSH the plugin exposes:

- **tool** `gitnexus_coverage` — `{ repo, includeLanguages? }`
- **route** `GET /api/gitnexus/coverage?repo=<project>` — one report, plus the
  maintenance commands for that project
- **panel** — a right-sidebar tab type `gitnexus`, opened from the sidebar's **+** →
  guide page ("GitNexus 索引")

The coverage route is read-only and accepts only directories that are already GitNexus
indexes, so it cannot be turned into a filesystem probe; it is additionally
restricted to loopback peers because a third-party DSH route is unauthenticated by
default on a bare `dsh web` profile.

There is now a **second** route, `/api/gitnexus/analyze`, and it is the only one that
can change anything. It answers `POST` to start an incremental refresh, `GET` to report
where that got to, and `DELETE` to stop it. It is a separate module from the coverage
route so the read-only half keeps a method policy that cannot mutate — the shared guard
takes the accepted methods from the route rather than hard-coding one set for both. The
mutating verbs additionally pass the write guard, which refuses cross-origin requests;
loopback alone is not enough, because any page the operator visits can reach
`127.0.0.1`. See **Maintenance** below for what it will and will not do.

## TypeScript, and why the build looks the way it does

The source is TypeScript under `strict`, including `noImplicitAny`. That is not
decoration: an implicit `any` is a **silent** failure — it does not report an error,
it just makes the checker stop working exactly where it was needed. Migrating this
codebase from JS+JSDoc to real types surfaced six places where the documentation and
the code disagreed, none of which produced a runtime error until the affected branch
was reached:

| Where | JSDoc claimed | Actually |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LargeFile.generatedHint` | `string \| null` | `boolean` — consumed as `if (x)` |
| `LargeFile.minified` | non-null | nullable, when the probe budget runs out |
| `analyzer.primitives` | `number` | a **string**, compared against `'gitnexus'` |
| `MinifiedVerdict` | a type name | **the type did not exist** |
| `activityView()` result | — | missing `truncated`, which callers read |
| `analyzeCoverage` options | 3 fields | 5 — two were undocumented |

### Two compile targets, no bundler

```
src/index.ts ───────────┐
src/gitnexus/*.ts ──────┤ tsc  (NodeNext)   → lib/**/*.js + *.d.ts    ESM
src/routes/*.ts ────────┤
src/bin/*.ts ───────────┘

src/client/index.ts ────→ tsc  (CommonJS)   → build/client/index.js
                                             ↓ text wrap (scripts/build-client.mjs)
                                             lib/client.js
```

The browser half needs no bundler because it **is** one module: its only imports are
platform baseline modules (`react`, the UI primitives) supplied by the loader's own
`require` at runtime, and it has no relative imports at all. `tsc --module commonjs`
therefore emits exactly one self-contained file, and the wrap is a text operation. A
bundler would add a dependency and a resolution graph to solve a problem this package
does not have.

`esModuleInterop` is **off** for the client target on purpose: it makes
`import * as React from 'react'` compile to a bare `const React = require("react")`,
which is precisely what the loader factory provides. With interop on, tsc injects an
`__importStar` helper that would ride along in every page load.

### `scripts/*.mjs` stays JavaScript (deliberate)

`scripts/link-runtime.mjs` runs from `postinstall`, and `scripts/build-client.mjs` is
the build driver itself. A bootstrap script **must not depend on the build it
bootstraps** — if those needed compiling, a fresh clone's `npm install` would fail
because `lib/` does not exist yet. `src/**` and `bin/**` are TypeScript; `scripts/`
is plain ESM, and that line is intentional rather than unfinished.

### Runtime packages ship no type declarations

`@deeps

plugins.description: A continue button beside the composer send key in the DSH Web GUI: one click sends an interruption-aware continuation prompt so an interrupted task picks up where it stopped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-continue-button

DSH Web GUI 的**「继续」按钮**插件：在对话框发送键旁边加一个圆形按钮，
点一下就把「续接指令」写进草稿并自动发送，让被中断的任务接着往下做。

- 挂载点：`conversation.input.activity`（DSH 官方定义为 *"Compact action after the model selector; it can expand across the toolbar while retaining the editor and submit action."*），
  位于模型选择器**右侧**、发送/停止主键**正左侧**，实测间距 12px。
  该槽被占用时自动回退到 `conversation.input.right`（模型选择器左侧）。
- 形态：纯客户端插件，无宿主服务依赖、无网络请求、无系统提示词注入。
- 交付形态：手写 lazy-CJS bundle（`client.js`），零构建依赖。

---

## 一、它做了什么

| 场景 | 点击行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话已中断 / 回合出错 | 读取中断原因 + 尾部上下文，生成结构化续接指令，自动发送 |
| 会话仍在运行 | 同样发送；因为走 `mode:"queue"`，该条会排入下一回合队列，不打断当前回合 |
| 草稿里已有文字 | 把续接指令**追加**到现有草稿之后一起发送（不覆盖你写的东西） |
| 按住 Alt 点击 / 右键点击 | 只发送裸的 `继续` 两个字，不带任何上下文 |

发送后按钮会闪一下（900ms）作为反馈。

### 生成的续接指令长什么样

smart 模式（默认）产出四段：

```
继续。

【中断状态】上一次「send」失败：ECONNRESET socket hang up

【当前任务】把插件挂到 profile 上
【中断前最后输出（结尾片段）】已改完三个文件，接下来准备跑测试。
（上一回合被中止，末尾内容不完整）
【回合终止】INTERRUPTED 用户中止

请从中断点直接接着往下做：不要重复已完成的内容，不要重新解释背景，直接给出下一步动作。
```

`【中断状态】` 按以下优先级取第一个命中的信号：

1. `session.promptError` —— 真实的发送/停止失败（带 code 与 message）
2. `session.lastAgentError` —— 上一回合的错误
3. transcript 尾部 `turn-error` / `turn-max-tokens` 节点
4. `session.awaitingFirstTurn` —— 提示已提交但首回合尚未开始
5. `session.running === true` —— 仍在运行，本条会排队
6. `input.queue.length` —— 队列里还有待执行消息
7. 兜底：`上一回合已结束，等待继续`

上下文段落全部来自**当前会话的已加载 transcript**（`ChatSnapshot.legacy.nodes`），
不读取磁盘上的会话日志，也不做额外请求。

---

## 二、安装

插件已经在 `C:\Users\candi\.dsh\profiles\web` 里装好了。若要在别的 profile 或机器上重装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add file:J:/plugin/dsh-continue-button
```

这条命令会做两件事：

1. 把 `"dsh-continue-button": "file:J:/plugin/dsh-continue-button"` 写进 profile 的 `dependencies`；
2. 把 `"dsh-continue-button"` 追加到 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表。

装完后**必须重启 `dsh web`**：浏览器半边的 bundle 由宿主启动时的
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 扫描 `dsh.client` 声明并合成 `__DSH_BOOT__` 图，
运行中的进程不会重新扫描 **profile 名册**，所以首次安装必须重启。

装完之后再改 `client.js` 就**不需要重启**了 —— 见下面「热更新」一节。

### 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-continue-button
```

然后手工把 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的 `"dsh-continue-button"` 一行删掉，再重启。

---

## 三、目录结构

```
dsh-continue-button/
├── package.json          # 双面包清单：exports["."] 宿主半边，exports["./client"] 浏览器半边
├── index.js              # 宿主半边：仅记录装载，无副作用
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：手写 lazy-CJS bundle（真正干活的部分）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch：把插件行插进 profile 名册
├── test/
│   ├── load-check.mjs    # 45 项：bundle 装载 / 槽位注册与回退 / 组件渲染与点击 / 续接文案生成
│   └── install-check.mjs # 19 项：安装面（profile 登记 / resolveMeta 判定链 / bundle 快照）
└── README.md
```

`client.js` 里的关键常量：

| 常量 | 值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PRIMARY_SLOT` | `conversation.input.activity` | 首选挂载槽位（紧贴发送键） |
| `FALLBACK_SLOT` | `conversation.input.right` | 首选被占用或 2s 内未声明时的回退槽位 |
| `FALLBACK_MS` | `2000` | 等待首选槽声明的超时 |
| `ENTRY_ID` | `continue-button` | 列表条目的 cell key（自定义 id = 加法式新增，不遮蔽官方控件） |
| `ENTRY_ORDER` | `50` | 在槽位内升序排列 |

落点策略：`activity` 是 **single** 槽（同 priority 二次注册会 throw），所以注册包在 `try/catch` 里；
抛错或超时即切到 `input.right`（**list** 槽，加法式，不会与 dsh-purge 的同名槽冲突）。
两条路径都在 `ctx.effect` 里登记了定时器清理，fiber 卸载时不会留下悬挂 timer。
按钮元素带 `data-slot` 属性，DOM 探针可直接看出它落在哪个槽。

---

## 四、验证

```powershell
node J:\plugin\dsh-continue-button\test\load-check.mjs
node J:\plugin\dsh-continue-button\test\install-check.mjs
```

两份脚本都不依赖 DSH 运行时：`load-check.mjs` 用 `node:vm` 在沙箱里模拟
`window.__ModuleLoader__` 与 `require`，把 `client.js` 真正跑一遍并断言注册行为与文案输出；
`install-check.mjs` 复刻 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 的 `resolveMeta` 判定链
（`parseDshClient` / `clientExportOf` / bundle 存在性 / `artifactRevision`），
对**已安装到 profile 的那份副本**逐条核对。

已验证的事实（实测输出）：

```
load-check.mjs    : 45/45 通过
install-check.mjs : 19/19 通过
```

`load-check.mjs` 覆盖的不只是「能加载」，还包括**点击行为的真实断言**：
把函数组件逐层展开到宿主 `<button>`，然后直接调用它的 `onClick` / `onContextMenu`，
断言 `setDraft` 收到的文本内容与 `submit` 的调用次序（含草稿追加、busy 禁用、降级不崩）。

宿主侧配置合成也已确认插件行进入 loader 名册：

```powershell
node C:\Users\candi\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js --profile web --dump-config
# 输出尾部包含：
#   # == dsh-continue-button
#   - id: dsh-continue-button
#     name: dsh-continue-button
```

### 运行时验证（已完成）

在 3099 端口起了**第二个独立实例**（`DSH_WEB_ALLOW_MULTI=1`，不碰用户正在用的 3080），
用 Playwright 打开并实测：

| 验证项 | 实测结果 |
| --- | --- |
| bundle 是否被浏览器加载 | `window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries` 含 `dsh-continue-button` |
| 按钮是否渲染 | `.dshcb-btn` 数量 = 1，`aria-label="继续"` |
| CSS 是否注入 | `<style data-plugin-css="dsh-continue-button/continue-button.css">` 在页内 |
| 落在哪个槽 | `data-slot = "conversation.input.activity"` |
| 祖父容器 | `uV2eYG_activity`（activity 槽的官方容器） |
| 与发送键的间距 | 按钮 x=1051（宽 28）→ 发送键 x=1091，**间距 12px** |
| 端到端点击 | 点击后页面标题变为 `继续。 【中断状态】上一回合 — DeepSeek Harness`，草稿被消费、续接指令进入 transcript |

实测位置序列（同一行，x 升序）：

```
添加(429) → 访问模式(469) → 凭据(581) → 回退(733) → 模型选择器(803,宽235) → 【继续】(1051,宽28) → 发送(1091,宽34)
```

截图：[docs/screenshot-composer.png](docs/screenshot-composer.png)（composer 全栈，按钮带红框）、
[docs/screenshot-button.png](docs/screenshot-button.png)（卡片特写）。

**另外核对了「3080 主实例服务的就是这份代码」**（不依赖重启与否的猜测）：

```powershell
# 从 3080 拉下它实际服务的 bundle，与磁盘副本逐字节比对
curl.exe -g -s -o served.js "http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/??dsh-continue-button/client.js&rev=<当前 rev>"
node -e "const f=require('fs');const a=f.readFileSync('served.js'),b=f.readFileSync('<profile>/node_modules/dsh-continue-button/client.js');console.log('磁盘文件是服务字节的精确前缀:',a.subarray(0,b.length).equals(b))"
# → true（尾部多出的 76 字节是 sourceMappingURL 注释）
```

两个实例（3080 与 3099）在 `/plugins/events` SSE 里报告的 rev 也完全一致（`e42e71719f95`）。

### 热更新（改完不用重启）

DSH 自带 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr`：它以 **500ms 间隔 stat 轮询**每个 graph row 的
`client.js`，发现 `mtimeMs / ctimeMs / size` 任一变化就调 `clientModules.rebuilt(id)`
重算 rev，再通过 `/plugins/events`（SSE）把 `{type:'rebuilt', id, rev}` 推给浏览器；
浏览器半边收到后走 `entries.reload(id, rev)`，重新拉取并替换该插件。

所以流程是：

1. 改 `J:\plugin\dsh-continue-button\client.js`；
2. 同步到宿主真正加载的那份：`Copy-Item client.js C:\Users\candi\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-continue-button\ -Force`；
3. 等约 1 秒（500ms 轮询 + 一次 SSE 往返），浏览器自动换新版 —— **不用重启，不用刷新页面**。

rev 只由 `mtime / ctime / size` 决定，不哈希内容 —— 所以「内容变了但三者都没变」的写入不会被发现
（正常编辑不会发生）。想确认当前服务的 rev：

```powershell
curl.exe -g -s "http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/events" | Select-String "dsh-continue-button"
```

### 仍受限制的部分

- **首次安装**必须重启 `dsh web`：profile 名册（`dsh.profile.bundles`）只在启动时扫描一次，
  HMR 只管**已在 graph 里**的 row 的字节变化，不会发现新插件。
- `client.js` 的改动必须同步到 `profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-continue-button/` 才会被加载
  （本次已同步，SHA256 一致）。若直接改源文件而忘了同步，宿主读到的仍是旧副本。

---

## 五、排查

**按钮没出现**，按顺序查：

1. **首次安装**重启过 `dsh web` 了吗？（未重启 = 名册里没有 = 一定不出现。装好之后再改 `client.js` 不必重启，HMR 会热更新）
2. `dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String continue-button` 有没有输出？
   没有 → profile 登记没生效，重跑安装命令。
3. 浏览器控制台有没有 `[dsh-continue-button] client bundle 注册失败：…`？
   有 → `client.js` 在注册期抛错，看具体报错。
4. 有没有 `client-modules: client bundle not found`？
   有 → `exports["./client"]` 指向的文件不在，检查 `node_modules/dsh-continue-button/client.js` 是否存在。
5. 控制台里 `window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries` 有没有 `dsh-continue-button` 这一行？

**点了没反应**：控制台会打印 `[dsh-continue-button] 发送失败：…`。
`inputActions` 缺失（说明该会话的 composer 未挂载）时按钮静默无操作，属预期降级。

**想改成只发纯「继续」**：按住 Alt 点击，或右键点击。

---

## 六、设计取舍

- **为什么用 `setDraft` + `submit`，而不是 `ctx.conversation.send()`**：
  `inputActions.submit()` 走完整的 composer 提交事务（乐观回显、失败恢复草稿、附件处理、分析埋点），
  与用户手按发送键完全同一条路径；`conversation.send()` 是绕过 composer 的服务直发，
  失败时不会把草稿还给用户。前者体验更一致。
- **为什么 `mode` 是 `queue`**：`inputActions.submit()` 内部固定 `this.submit("queue")`，
  这是 DSH 的既定行为，插件无法也不应改写它。副作用正好符合需求 —— 中断时追加回合、运行中排队不打断。
- **为什么不读磁盘会话日志**：客户端插件拿不到也不该拿宿主文件；transcript 尾部信息已经足够定位中断点，
  且不会引入 IO 失败面。
- **为什么手写 bundle**：纯客户端插件用 tsdown 打包的唯一收益是类型检查，而
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` 等类型包在本机只能靠 vendored 副本提供；
  手写形态与 `dsh-infinite-gen-5` 已在同机验证可行，且零构建依赖 —— 配合 DSH 自带的
  `dsh-client-hmr`，改完同步副本约一秒即热更新，连重启都不需要。
- **为什么落在 `activity` 而不是 `input.right`**：`input.right` 是 list 槽、加法式最安全，
  但它渲染在 `standardControls` 里、**模型选择器左侧**，与发送键隔着一个 235px 宽的模型选择器；
  `activity` 渲染在模型选择器**右侧**、停止/发送键正左侧（`trailing` 的 12px gap），才真的算「发送键旁」。
  代价是 `activity` 是 `single` 槽 —— 同 priority 二次注册会 throw，所以注册包在 try/catch 里，
  失败或槽位未声明时 2 秒后回退到 `input.right`（两条路径都可用，按钮的 `data-slot` 属性会写明实际落点）。

Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**
